jobs.title: Temporary Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Why Join JVS?**


JVS is a nonprofit working to close opportunity gaps in employment by supporting jobseekers with the skills and confidence to secure quality careers with family\-sustaining wages. Grounded in core values of repairing the world and focused on helping our program participants achieve economic mobility, we believe everyone deserves access to training and the chance for a good job. JVS develops training programs in close partnership with employers in high growth sectors, offering high quality jobs.


Building on decades of experience and success, JVS is a data\-driven organization that takes a whole systems approach to addressing employment and economic equity. Through our direct service programs, employer engagement and policy change, JVS is working toward a future where everyone has access to quality education and training programs that lead to high quality employment and economic mobility.  

  

**Job Summary:**


The Temporary Program Coordinator plays a pivotal role in supporting participants throughout their enrollment and career development journeys. This position ensures accurate assessment, application review, and data management, while also providing personalized coaching and guidance.  

The role involves participating in program orientations, developing career action plans, monitoring participant progress, and collaborating with internal teams and external partners. Success is measured by the ability to meet enrollment and cohort targets, support participant retention, and foster positive outcomes in career placement. A strong commitment to equity, inclusion, and excellent customer service is essential. This role is full\-time, limited\-term, and anticipated to end on 06/30/2027\.

**Responsibilities:**

**Application \& Assessment**

* Review and evaluate program applications for candidate suitability.
* Coordinate and participate in interviews using established criteria to determine participant qualifications.
* Enter and maintain accurate participant records and assessment data in Salesforce or similar systems.

**Program Orientation \& Coaching*** Participate in orientations to introduce participants to program expectations, resources, and support services.
* Provide ongoing coaching and feedback to guide candidates through enrollment and career development.

**Participant Journey Management*** Track and monitor participant progress through career action plans and program milestones.
* Meet regularly with participants during their course and job search phases.
* Refer participants to external services for barriers beyond program scope.

**Support \& Engagement**

* Maintain positive connections among participants, staff, and cohorts.
* Process participant resource dollars and support access to necessary resources.
* Inform participants about their progress and required actions to advance.

**Administrative \& Data Management**

* Document participant encounters and barriers in Salesforce.
* Manage schedules to ensure participants stay on track with program and job search timelines.
* Collaborate with partner agencies and other program staff to ensure effective communication with participants and across agencies.
* Complete administrative projects in support of the Program Team.

**Performance Monitoring**

* Track participant outcomes and support progress toward sustainable wage careers.
* Monitor and encourage the application of behavioral skills in classroom and workplace settings.

**Qualifications:**

* 1–3 years of experience in a similar role.
* Experience working with diverse populations and a demonstrated commitment to equity and inclusion.
* Proven ability to help individuals achieve career or educational goals.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record\-keeping.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to learn Salesforce or similar CRM systems.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for building rapport with participants and stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time management skills to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* Ability to analyze participant needs and develop personalized action plans.
* Competence in documenting and tracking participant progress using CRM systems.
* Strong problem\-solving skills to address participant barriers and critical incidents.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team and with external partners.
* Flexibility and adaptability to meet changing organizational and participant needs.
* High degree of initiative, integrity, and professionalism.
* Commitment to the mission and values of JVS.
* Positive attitude and genuine desire to help participants succeed.


**What We Offer*** $3,062\.50 per pay period
* 100% covered medical and dental plans for the employee
* Accrued sixteen (16\) days of Vacation \+ accrued ten (10\) days of Paid Sick Leave
* Paid federal and Jewish holidays
* 3% 403(b) retirement contribution match and 3% non\-elective contribution
* Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
* Pet Insurance Discounts
* Employee Assistance Program
* The expectation for this role is to work in our San Francisco office and/or worksites on a hybrid work schedule; JVS does not provide relocation packages
* 4 Day Work Week

*As an Equal Opportunity Employer, JVS is committed to providing employment opportunities to all qualified individuals and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information or characteristics, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. We welcome diverse applicants. Please let us know if you need accommodations or auxiliary aids for the interview process.*

We seek people who can think the big ideas and deliver upon the small details. If you are creative, adaptive, and talented, then you might have found a home with us!

**Experience:** Three (3\) years of progressively responsible and directly related work experience.

**Licensure/Certification:** ATA certification required. ATA certification may be waived with a master's degree in Translation.

jobs.title: Electrical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

Shimmick, via our subsidiary Axia Electric, is seeking an experienced and results\-driven **Electrical Project Manager** in Northern California/Bay Area/East Bay region to lead the successful execution of electrical construction projects from contract award through closeout. This role carries full responsibility for the overall performance of assigned projects, including safety, financial outcomes, schedule adherence, client satisfaction, and team leadership.  

The Project Manager acts as the primary representative of Axia Electric to the client and is accountable for delivering projects that meet or exceed contractual obligations while aligning with company goals and standards.  

At Axia Electric, we are problem solvers. Creative thinkers. Innovators. We approach each project with fresh ideas and big thinking in pursuit of better answers, better outcomes, and better experiences for our clients. We are resourceful, nimble and resilient. We work hard together—and with our clients—to deliver high\-quality projects that are on time, on budget and beyond expectations. **Axia Electric**
Since the early 1990s, Shimmick has been self\-performing electrical scopes for infrastructure projects. In 2025 the Electrical Division rebranded to Axia Electric, a subsidiary to Shimmick Construction. Axia offers electrical, instrumentation, and process controls expertise for water and wastewater treatment; dams and locks; mass transit and rail; alternative energy; power generation and transmission; and commercial building projects. Our ability to self\-perform this specialty offers additional value and enables us to better control cost and schedule for projects with major electrical and process mechanical scopes. Our clients include municipalities, water districts, sanitation districts, transit agencies, private developers, DOTs, and USACE  

Axia Electric, headquartered in Riverside, California, focuses on large public owners in several states, across water resources, water treatment, transportation and transit markets. Over the past decade, the division has grown tremendously, securing major projects, including the $350 million North City Pure Water Facility in San Diego and the $235 million EVMWD Regional Water Reclamation Facility Expansion Project in Lake Elsinore, CA.

 **Why Axia Electric**


At Axia Electric, Project Managers play a critical role in driving our reputation for excellence. This position offers the opportunity to lead impactful projects, build meaningful client relationships, and contribute directly to the company’s growth and success.  


Responsibilities:

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to the following: **Project Leadership \& Execution*** Lead all aspects of project operations, including planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout
* Ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with contract requirements
* Oversee project setup, procurement, subcontracting, and resource allocation
* Identify and proactively manage risks, including cost exposure, schedule delays, and scope changes

**Safety \& Compliance*** Champion a strong safety culture and ensure adherence to all company and regulatory safety standards
* Ensure the safety and wellbeing of all employees, subcontractors, and partners on assigned projects

**Financial Management*** Maintain full accountability for project financial performance, including forecasting, cost control, and profitability
* Safeguard company funds, assets, and resources
* Manage project budgets, change orders, billing, and cash flow
* Evaluate and mitigate financial risks associated with project execution

**Client \& Stakeholder Management*** Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, building and maintaining strong, long\-term relationships
* Ensure client satisfaction through consistent communication, responsiveness, and delivery excellence
* Represent Axia Electric professionally in all client interactions
* Support business development by identifying opportunities for repeat and future work

**Team Leadership \& Coordination*** Lead cross\-functional project teams including field personnel, engineers, subcontractors, and vendors
* Provide clear direction, mentorship, and performance oversight to project team members
* Coordinate effectively with internal departments such as estimating, procurement, and operations

**Project Complexity \& Risk Management*** Successfully manage projects across varying levels of financial risk and operational complexity
* Assess and adapt management approach based on factors such as:
	+ Contract value and project duration
	+ Scope and technical complexity
	+ Availability of proven methods or technologies
	+ Environmental, safety, and working conditions
	+ Labor, subcontractor, or joint venture requirements
	+ Contractual risks including liquidated damages, guarantees, and liabilities
* Ensure appropriate planning and execution strategies are applied based on project profile
  


Qualifications:
**Minimum Requirements:*** Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field \+ 6 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

**Preferred Qualifications:*** 10\+ years of experience managing or supporting complex heavy civil or industrial electrical construction projects
* Experience working in underground, confined, or highly regulated environments (e.g., transit systems or similar infrastructure)
* Background in water/wastewater, transportation, or power\-related infrastructure projects
* Strong understanding of electrical power distribution and control systems, including switchgear, transformers, generators, and backup power systems
* Ability to read and interpret complex drawings and schematics (single\-line diagrams, P\&IDs, control systems, and coordination plans)
* Experience with installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical and instrumentation/c

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Operations Analyst (Temporary)
jobs.description:
Simpson Strong\-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry. We maintain a reputation as a trusted manufacturer, partner, and corporate citizen committed to our customers and employees.


Our founder, Barc Simpson established 9 Principles of Business we live out as company values and have made Simpson Strong\-Tie an inspiring place to work since 1956\. Our team of talented people are dedicated to our shared mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures.


Learn about our company culture directly from our team.

**YOU**
=======


This temporary 4–6\-month position offers an opportunity to play a critical role in advancing Talent Acquisition operations. As the Talent Acquisition Operations Analyst, you will serve as a strategic operations, analytics, and enablement partner for the Talent Acquisition team. You will translate recruiting data into clear insights, lead or support TA technology implementations, standardize processes and resources, and create scalable tools that improve hiring consistency, speed, quality, and candidate experience. This role partners closely with HR partners, hiring managers, HR operations, communications, and external vendors to turn strategy into practical execution.


This position requires a proactive, detail\-oriented problem solver who can manage complex projects, communicate clearly across audiences, troubleshoot systems and process gaps, and use data to influence continuous improvement across the recruiting lifecycle.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**
========================

**Talent Acquisition Analytics, Reporting and Insights (30%)**


Generate, analyze and communicate TA metrics that help leadership, recruiters, HR partners and business stakeholders understand recruiting performance, hiring trends and opportunities for improvement.

* Maintain and improve recurring and ad hoc reporting on requisition volume, time\-to\-fill/time\-to\-offer, offer approvals, source performance, recruiter workload, platform usage, referral and internal applicant activity, quality\-of\-hire inputs and early turnover trends.
* Prepare quarterly TA performance reviews, executive summaries, dashboards, and slide\-ready insights that highlight progress, risks, root causes and recommended actions.
* Maintain and enhance recruiter scorecards, operational tracking tools and KPI frameworks to support accountability, prioritization and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Analyze applicant funnel health, sourcing channel performance and location\-specific challenges to inform proactive sourcing, advertising and candidate flow strategies.

**TA Technology, Systems and Process Optimization (30%)**


Lead and support implementation, adoption and continuous improvement of TA systems and workflows, with a focus on scalable, compliant and user\-friendly recruiting operations.

* Serve as a key TA project partner for recruiting technology initiatives, including Paradox/Ty interview scheduling and referrals, SHL assessment integration, HiredScore implementation, Workday recruiting enhancements and related platform changes.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing, system troubleshooting, hypercare support, issue logs, enhancement requests, access questions and cross\-functional follow\-up with HR systems, IT and vendors.
* Partner with TA and business stakeholders to standardize intake forms, job description/job posting content, required vs. preferred skills mapping, stage definitions, candidate communications and disposition templates.
* Evaluate system adoption and process gaps, recommend improvements, and develop scalable solutions that reduce manual work, improve consistency and strengthen candidate and hiring manager experience.

**Program, Project and Change Management (25%)**


Plan, coordinate and execute TA programs and strategic initiatives from concept through rollout, ensuring stakeholders are aligned, resources are ready, and adoption is supported.

* Update and maintain the Talent Acquisition Playbook, Hiring Manager Portal resources, job aids, FAQs, templates, process documentation and operating standards for recruiters, HR partners and hiring managers.
* Develop and deliver training and change\-management materials for new TA processes and tools, including live sessions, My Workbench content, recordings, guides, communication drafts and follow\-up resources.
* Support structured interviewing, hiring events, dedicated interview pool pilots, first\-year turnover improvement work, candidate experience initiatives and quality\-of\-hire measurement efforts.
* Manage project plans, agendas, meeting cadences, action items and stakeholder updates to keep cross\-functional work moving and aligned to TA priorities.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Recruiting Operations Partnership (15%)**


Act as a central coordination point across TA, HR, business leaders and external partners to strengthen recruiting operations, vendor effectiveness and stakeholder experience.

* Partner with recruiters, HRBPs and hiring managers on recruiting process improvements, branch/location hiring challenges, priority requisitions and manager communication needs.
* Manage or support vendor relationships and utilization for platforms and partners such as Paradox, Workday, SHL, HiredScore, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed and related recruiting tools.
* Support recruiter and hiring manager enablement through clear communication, meeting facilitation, resource sharing, troubleshooting and escalation of system or process issues.
* Contribute to employer brand, employee referral, social media spotlight, community outreach and candidate communication initiatives that improve attraction and engagement.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Data Analytics, Communications, Organizational Development or a related field required.3\+years of experience in Human Resources:

jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience creating go\-to\-market strategies.
* Experience working with product marketing teams.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience working with various digital marketing channels in an e\-commerce, gaming, or digital content business.
* Experience working with a product/engineering team to launch new products, features or consumer programs for global companies.
* Previous business planning or chief of staff responsibilities (e.g., Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), budget, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR), etc.).
* Strong understanding of program management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall).

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


Google Play is at the heart of the Android ecosystem, providing the apps, games, and digital content that bring Android devices to life. The Play store serves more than 2\.5B users across over 190 countries, and is a critical driver of Google’s overall business growth. Googlers working on the Play Go\-To\-Market (GTM) teams own content strategy and publishing within the Play Store across all regions and verticals (Apps, Games, and more).


As a Program Manager, you will work on a large portfolio of innovative products and programs such as new and engaging mechanics that can enhance user engagement while strengthening proven capabilities to improve scalability and robustness.


In this role, you will collaborate closely with all of the teams involved with Go\-To\-Market programs and tooling solutions including product marketing, product, engineering, finance, partnerships, operations, and more to create and execute GTM plans, manage launches, and scale the business.


Google Play offers music, movies, books, apps and games for devices, powered by the cloud. It syncs across devices and on the web. As part of the Android and Mobile team, Googlers working on Google Play do everything from engineering our backend systems, to shaping product strategy, to forming great content partnerships. They make it possible for people to do things like buy an ebook or song on their Android phone, then have it instantly available on their laptop. The Google Play team enhances the Android ecosystem by giving developers and partners a premium store where they can reach millions of users.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Be responsible for managing and delivering on a large portfolio of projects in various strategic areas for Play including (but not limited to) games and apps GTM, loyalty programs and new Play transformation or expansion programs.

jobs.description:
**About Clipboard**
===================


Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app\-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

  

Founded in 2016, we are a remote\-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y\-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022\. We’re the leader in Long\-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

**The Role**
------------


Clipboard Health is a marketplace that connects healthcare facilities with professionals looking for shifts.


Our largest customers operate at significant scale, and their problems don't always fit neatly into a single team or function. A product implementation might stall because of an operational workflow. A payroll issue might involve the customer, our Operations team, Product, and Engineering. An integration might technically work but fail to work for the people actually using it.


We need someone who can step into those situations and figure them out.


As a **Forward Deployed Operations Manager**, you'll work directly with some of our most important enterprise customers to solve complex operational and product problems. You'll get close to the customer, understand how their business actually works, diagnose what's going wrong, and coordinate the people needed to fix it.


You won't necessarily have direct authority over the teams doing the work. Instead, you'll create clarity, build alignment, and keep things moving.

**Your job is to take a messy problem and turn it into a solved problem.**


Some days that might mean analyzing data to understand why a customer's staffing workflow isn't working. Other days might involve coordinating a complex implementation across Product, Engineering, and Operations, troubleshooting a payroll or time clock issue, or working with a customer's leadership team to get a stalled initiative back on track.


The problems will change. The expectation won't: **you own the outcome.**

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own complex customer and operational problems from diagnosis through resolution
* Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their workflows, challenges, and goals
* Build relationships with customer stakeholders ranging from frontline operators to VP and Director\-level leaders
* Diagnose problems by combining customer conversations, operational context, data, and system behavior
* Break ambiguous problems into clear workstreams, priorities, owners, and timelines
* Lead complex customer implementations, particularly involving time clock compliance, payroll, and integrations with systems like ADP and UKG
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to investigate issues, define solutions, and drive execution
* Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Operations, and customer teams to remove blockers and keep critical initiatives moving
* Manage expectations and communicate clearly when timelines, priorities, or solutions change
* Identify recurring operational and customer problems and turn those insights into improvements to our product and processes
* Build new processes or approaches when existing ones aren't sufficient to solve the problem
* Travel to customer sites occasionally when being there in person will help move an important problem or implementation forward

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 2–6 years of experience in consulting, operations, strategy and operations, implementation, customer strategy, program management, or a similar problem\-solving role
* Experience working directly with customers or clients, particularly in complex or high\-stakes situations
* Strong structured problem\-solving skills. You can take an ambiguous problem, figure out what matters, and create a path forward
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to investigate problems and make decisions
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both senior executives and frontline operators
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence teams without direct authority
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple workstreams, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously
* A strong sense of ownership. You care about the ultimate outcome, not just completing your assigned tasks
* Curious and resourceful. You're comfortable learning new systems, processes, and industries quickly
* Persistent when things get messy. You don't give up when the first solution doesn't work
* Comfortable getting into the weeds. You'll need to understand operational details, systems, data, and processes to solve many of the problems you'll encounter

**Consulting backgrounds are a particularly strong fit**, especially candidates who have experience working with complex clients, structuring ambiguous problems, and driving cross\-functional projects. We're also open to candidates from operations, implementation, product, program management, and other backgrounds with the same core skill set.


We're looking for people who are ready to move beyond simply identifying problems or making recommendations. You want to be the person responsible for making the solution work.

**Location**
------------


This is an onsite role based in our San Francisco office for \~2 days per week. We're also open to candidates who are willing to relocate to the Bay Area.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  

Spectro Cloud helps platform teams and cloud providers modernize and manage infrastructure for the AI era without adding more tools or operational complexity.


With PaletteAI, enterprises, public sector organizations, neoclouds and sovereign clouds can build, govern and operate full\-stack environments across VMs, Kubernetes, edge, regulated and air\-gapped locations, and AI infrastructure. PaletteAI Launchpads help teams start quickly with urgent outcomes such as VMware migration, token cost control or edge modernization, then scale into enterprise\-wide lifecycle management, governance and fleet operations on the same platform.

**About the Team**  

Marketing at Spectro Cloud runs fast, and the systems underneath need to keep up. We're hiring our first dedicated Senior Marketing Operations Manager to own the plumbing that makes everything work — the workflows, the data, the leads, the nurtures, and the reporting that leadership and the board rely on. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role reporting to the Director of Demand Gen. You'll be the person who makes marketing operations a durable, well\-architected system that scales with the business. You'll partner closely with demand generation, field marketing, web, sales, and RevOps, and you'll have a direct line into how pipeline gets built, measured, and reported.
  

  

**What You'll Do**
  

Lead flow, system architecture, and automation
* Own how leads move through HubSpot and into Salesforce end\-to\-end
* Build and maintain campaign workflows
* Manage HubSpot Salesforce integration, field mapping, and lifecycle stage handoffs
* Add and maintain the properties needed for routing, reporting, and sales visibility
* Troubleshoot sync errors and process breakdowns as they arise

  

Campaign and event operations
* Manage landing pages, forms, and campaign assets in HubSpot
* Upload and process event lead lists; route qualified leads into the right nurture sequences
* QA campaign setup end\-to\-end — from lead capture through Salesforce sync
* Ensure lead source and channel tracking is consistent, complete, and reportable across trade shows, website, SEO, social, ABM, and paid programs

  

Data quality and system maintenance
* Own the ongoing integrity of marketing data.
* Monitor and resolve sync errors, incomplete records, and misrouted leads
* Investigate individual records when qualification, source, or history is questioned
* Own and enforce a consistent cross\-team UTM structure for digital campaigns

  

Lead scoring and lifecycle management
* Maintain and continuously improve the lead scoring and qualification model used by Marketing and Sales

 Ensure lifecycle stage definitions are clear, consistently applied, and aligned with how Sales works leads Nurture operations Build and maintain nurture programs in HubSpot, including entry/exit logic and progression rules
* Monitor performance and report on whether programs are actually moving leads forward
* Manage one off email sends for event invitation/follow up etc.

  

Reporting, dashboards, and attribution
* Build the reporting foundation for pipeline sourced and influenced by marketing, by source and channel
* Deliver campaign ROI reporting: target, actual, and attainment
* Maintain separate reporting views for Commercial and Public Sector
* Produce quarterly board\-ready reporting, including sourced/attributed vs. assisted/influenced, open vs. closed\-won, and created\-in\-quarter vs. trailing
* Develop a first version of a multi\-touch attribution model, and iterate from there

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

* 6\+ years in marketing operations at a B2B SaaS company, with at least 2–3 years at a senior/lead level in a builder role.
* Long term strategic thinker with a builder mindset.
* Deep, hands\-on HubSpot expertise — workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, custom properties, sync management, settings. You should be able to open HubSpot on day one and know exactly where to look.
* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce and of the HubSpot–Salesforce integration specifically (field mapping, sync rules, common failure modes)
* Experience owning lead routing, lifecycle management, and lead scoring end\-to\-end
* Track record of building nurture programs that actually move pipeline
* Comfort with attribution — multi\-touch models, sourced vs. influenced, and the tradeoffs between them
* Strong data instincts: you notice when numbers don't add up, and you know how to trace them back to the source
* Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills — this role sits at the seam between Marketing, Sales, and RevOps
* Comfortable operating autonomously in a fast\-moving, less\-than\-fully\-built environment
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Hands on experience with ABM platforms (6Sense, DemandBase), intent data tools, lead routing (LeanData)
* HubSpot Marketing Software and/or Salesforce Administrator certifications
* Experience building marketing ops from an early stage rather than inheriting a mature stack

  

Location: This role is hybrid in San Jose, CA. We are in office 3x a week, 2x WFH.  

Remote candidates in the Bay Area and in US will still be considered for this role.  

  

The On\-Target Earnings for this role is $142,500\-$195,500 \+ Equity.

jobs.title: Operations Manager (Transportation)
jobs.description:
Hallcon is a mobility and infrastructure services company focused on turnkey solutions for clients such as technology companies, manufacturers, railroads, universities, corporate business parks, hospitals, airports, public transportation agencies and more.
  
  

The Company provides essential transportation services including multi\-mode operations, integrated command centers, electric vehicle (EV) infrastructure, technology, analytics and business intelligence, maintenance, cleaning, and rider experience measurement. For more information, visit hallcon.com.
  
  

Position Overview
  
The Operations Manager reports directly to the General Manager (GM). This position helps the GM manage the day\-to\-day operations as part of the employee transportation program for our client at the San Francisco International Airport.
  
  

The Operations Manager is primarily responsible for the management of the employee workforce including but not limited to timekeeping, drafting and issuing disciplinary action, and administrative and operational training and oversight.
  
  

The Operations Manager will assist the GM in maintaining an effective working relationship with the client, the employees, multiple unions and other vendors.
  
  

Essential Job Responsibilities
  
Operational
  
Meet or exceed all Client expectations. This includes managing performance to the elements of the Scope of Work (SOW) and Service Level Agreements (SLA) applicable to the Operations Manager’s position.
  
  

Make sure all routes/runs are performed in a timely manner. Make sure the driver team has updated information on runs/routes to be covered, and have had hands\-on training for new routes, with turn\-by\-turn documentation. Drivers should be fully aware of factors that may cause delays when operating a new route. Be aware of all schedules and routes; oversee coverage, uncovered routes due to absences, or shifts not covered. Make sure alternatives are in place to respond to call outs, vehicle breakdowns, traffic conditions, etc.
  
  

**Create and manage an effective driver team:**  

Maintain a proficient extra board driving team to cover the assigned routes as necessary.
  
Make sure that drivers are compliant with all client and Hallcon requirements for:
  
* Performance
* Conduct
* Timeliness
* Attire


Must work very closely with Dispatch. Obtain latest information on driver and/or route coverage issues or other impacting transit delays. Must also be able to cover dispatch in instances of callouts. Monitor passenger complaints and service issues and report those issues to GM. Answer all email and phone inquiries in a timely and accurate manner.
  
  

Safety \& Compliance
  
Ensure Safety and Compliance, working with Safety Manager. Make sure all operational activities are conducted safely, in compliance with all applicable Federal, State and Local laws and regulations, and in accordance to Hallcon policies and guidelines. Making sure that all safety\-related information (accidents, incidents) is reported to the Client, and Safety Manager, in a timely manner.
  
  

Leadership
  
Be a motivational leader. Make sure that the drivers have an opportunity to share their views on a routine basis. Communicate driver’s views and questions to the ADO and the Hallcon Senior Leadership Team without filter or prejudice. Be empathetic to driver’s views; follow up on all driver issues in a timely manner. Keep your commitments to drivers. Control absenteeism and tardiness by consistently administering the attendance policy.
  
  

Promote passenger satisfaction. Monitor, and act upon, passenger complaints and service issues. Make sure that service alerts and notifications are generated and distributed promptly. Must make sure that drivers handle all passenger interactions in a courteous and professional manner.
  
  

Manage documentation and reports. This includes elements the Daily Activity Report (DAR), Ridership Report, and Accident \& Incident Log. Upon the direction of the GM, generate other client\-specific data or QBR related statistics. Designate and oversee personnel responsible for the creation and communication of daily KFI reports. And any other requested data/analytics collection and finalized reports.
  
Collaborate with GM to foster a relationship with union business agents and participate in union activities including, Contract Negotiations, Grievance, and assist in the preparation and implementation of shift and vacation bids.
  
  

Human Resources
  
Work with GM and Human Resources to forecast recruiting needs for employees. Maintain a file (electronic or hard copy) for all employees; add performance data with date and time, to aid in awarding incentives, performance reviews, corrective or disciplinary actions. Engage team members and promote job satisfaction. Make sure employees get the rest and meal periods as required by law.
  
Other duties as assigned
  
  

Education/Experience/Requirements
  
* Must have a minimum of 2 years of experience in managing customer service and in promoting and enhancing client relations.
* Must have a minimum of 5 years’ management experience in transportation/logistics including managing a large (50\+) driver team.
* Requires experience with FMCS regulations as prescribed by the US Department of Transportation.
* Must be able to work flexible hours as required, including weekends.
* Must have the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Must have excellent communications skills in English, including written communications and presentations.
* Ability to learn specialized programs (GPS\-based systems, operation of security cameras, plug\-in regenerative units, vehicle and driver database management program, generate reports on ridership counts, trends, etc.
* Must have intermediate computer skills and have experience with Microsoft Office
* Must set an example as a leader. This includes work ethics, work hours, attire, attitude, interpersonal communications, timelines

jobs.title: Sr. Global Operations Manager
jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**



Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy\-sensitive AI\-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.



We've got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100\+ of the Fortune 500\), a $5\.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.



You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform's impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI\-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that's alerted to a threat in real\-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We're rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170\+ countries.

### **About the Role**



As the Senior Global Operations Manager of Fulfillment \& Outbound Logistics, you will own Verkada's global 3PL network and oversee inbound, warehouse, and outbound logistics operations across multiple regions. You'll be responsible for optimizing supply chain performance, managing strategic logistics partners, driving cost savings, and ensuring world\-class service levels. We're looking for an experienced operations leader who thrives in fast\-paced environments, enjoys solving complex supply chain challenges, and is passionate about building scalable global logistics processes.


### **What You'll Do**


* Own and manage strategic partnerships with global 3PL providers, including vendor selection, contract negotiations, performance management, and quarterly business reviews.
* Oversee inbound, warehouse, and outbound logistics operations across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve service levels across the supply chain.
* Develop and monitor KPIs including freight costs, inventory performance, order accuracy, fill rates, and on\-time delivery.
* Manage inventory deployment strategies, distribution network optimization, and reverse logistics (RMA/refurbishment) programs.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Supply Chain, Planning, Operations, and external logistics providers to resolve operational issues and improve execution.
* Establish and maintain supply chain SOPs while driving adoption of best practices across internal teams and 3PL partners.
* Lead implementation and optimization of supply chain systems, including WMS, TMS, and ERP integrations.
* Present operational performance, trends, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
* Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week.

### **What You Bring**


* 8\+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or operations management, including 5\+ years managing 3PL partnerships.
* Experience overseeing global logistics operations across multiple regions and international supply chains.
* Strong background in warehouse, transportation, fulfillment, and distribution network management.
* Experience with WMS, TMS, ERP platforms, and advanced Excel for reporting and data analysis.
* Proven success driving cost reduction initiatives and improving operational efficiency through process optimization.
* Experience managing vendor relationships, negotiating contracts, and holding logistics providers accountable to SLAs.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate data into operational improvements.
* Excellent communication and project management skills with experience leading cross\-functional initiatives.
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field. APICS CSCP, Lean Six Sigma, or similar certifications are a plus.

### **Employee Benefits**



Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:


* Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well\-being needs \- Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
* Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
* Starting January 2027, Verkada will match a portion of an employee's 401(k) contributions based on eligible earnings. Match vests on 2 year anniversary
* Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
* Expanded mental health support
* Paid parental leave policy \& fertility benefits
* Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time
* Professional development stipend
* Wellness/fitness benefits
* Healthy lunches provided daily
* Commuter benefits

### **Additional Information**


* You must be independently authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time.

### **Verkada Is An Equal Opportunity Employer**



As an equal opportunity employer, Verkada is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Verkada will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.


*Your application will be handled in accordance with our* *Candidate Privacy Polic

jobs.title: Field Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Jetson**



Jetson is on a mission to accelerate the transition of 100 million homes across North America away from fossil fuels toward sustainable energy use. We believe in a future that is 100% electric and 100% better.



Homes are one of the largest sources of carbon emissions, yet adoption of solutions like heat pumps remains slow due to cost and complexity. Jetson is solving this by building the first fully vertically integrated home electrification company — making clean energy simple, transparent, and affordable.



We rely heavily on technology, automation, and data to scale this impact. At Jetson, we value people who are excellent at their craft, curious about new tools (including AI), and motivated to continuously improve how work gets done.

  


#### **The Opportunity:**



We are looking for an extremely motivated and passionate HVAC professional with field operations management who would like to be a part of an exciting new company looking to fight climate change through disrupting the residential HVAC industry. This marks our expansion in the California market. The Field Operations Manager is responsible for ensuring that the HVAC installation teams are fully supported and equipped to perform their work safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. This role bridges field operations and leadership, with a focus on readiness, resource allocation, and real\-time problem\-solving to drive team success. As we continue to iterate the processes and procedures that ensure the highest installation quality and efficiency, this role will play an integral role by contributing to the knowledge base.


#### **What You Will Do:**


* Ensure daily readiness of field teams by coordinating tools, equipment, vehicles, parts, and job documentation.
* Act as the primary liaison between the field crew and internal departments such as logistics, procurement, and scheduling.
* Conduct site visits to provide support, coaching, and quality assurance for active installation projects.
* Monitor and enforce company safety standards and ensure compliance with local codes and regulations.
* Identify operational obstacles and work proactively to resolve issues that impact field productivity or installation timelines.
* Conduct pre\-installation walkthroughs to ensure all project parameters
* Maintain an up\-to\-date understanding of the staffing needs based relevant business inputs.
* Train and mentor field technicians to improve workmanship, efficiency, and customer service.
* Review completed installations to ensure quality standards and customer expectations are met or exceeded.
* Support warranty and rework investigations and help implement corrective action plans.
* Provide performance feedback and assist with evaluations of field team members.
* Collaborate with senior leadership to develop and refine operational procedures and best practices.

#### **What You Bring:**


* Proven experience as an HVAC install team member and team lead.
* GA Conditioned Air Contractor (CAC) — Class I Restricted (State, RME Required; \#1 Gating Item)
* HVAC NATE and Section 608 certification preferred.
* 5\+ years in a management role, overseeing field teams.
* Strong knowledge of HVAC systems including heat pumps.
* Ability to lead, coach, and motivate field personnel.
* Ability to read blueprints and schematics.
* Familiarity with building codes and regulations.
* Excellent English communications and customer service skills.
* Proficiency with scheduling software, mobile work apps, field management tools and general business tools expertise.
* Valid driver's license and clean driving record.
* Excellent problem\-solving and organizational skills.
* Follows OSHA Electrical Standard
* Follows the Occupational Safety and Health Administration's (OSHA) Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) standard


**Job Type:**Full\-time, Permanent


**Pay:** **$115K \- $125K per year**


#### **Benefits:**



Dental Care, Vision Care \& Life Insurance premiums fully paid by Jetson



Health Insurance premium 85% paid by Jetson


Education Support



Parental Leave Top Up



401k program



Paid Tim Off to include Company Paid shut down from Dec 24th to Jan 1st



Holiday Pay


**Work Location:** In person \- San Jose, CA



*Do you feel like you don't have everything that's listed above but can still do the job? If you have the core skills and experience that we're looking for and are willing to use your talent to learn the rest, we encourage you to apply!*


**U.S. Roles** Jetson is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, or gender identity. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact us.


**Canada Roles** Jetson is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusive hiring. We do not discriminate on any ground protected under applicable human rights legislation. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience working with various digital marketing channels in an e\-commerce, gaming, or digital content business.
* Experience working with a product/engineering team to launch new products, features or consumer programs for global companies.
* Previous business planning or chief of staff responsibilities (e.g., Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), budget, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR), etc.).

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


Google Play is at the heart of the Android ecosystem, providing the apps, games, and digital content that bring Android devices to life. The Play store serves more than 2\.5B users across over 190 countries, and is a critical driver of Google’s overall business growth. Googlers working on the Play Go\-To\-Market (GTM) teams own content strategy and publishing within the Play Store across all regions and verticals (Apps, Games, and more).


As a Program Manager, you will work on a large portfolio of innovative products and programs such as new and engaging mechanics that can enhance user engagement while strengthening proven capabilities to improve scalability and robustness.


In this role, you will collaborate closely with all of the teams involved with Go\-To\-Market programs and tooling solutions including product marketing, product, engineering, finance, partnerships, operations, and more to create and execute GTM plans, manage launches, and scale the business.


Google Play offers music, movies, books, apps and games for devices, powered by the cloud. It syncs across devices and on the web. As part of the Android and Mobile team, Googlers working on Google Play do everything from engineering our backend systems, to shaping product strategy, to forming great content partnerships. They make it possible for people to do things like buy an ebook or song on their Android phone, then have it instantly available on their laptop. The Google Play team enhances the Android ecosystem by giving developers and partners a premium store where they can reach millions of users.

DELFI Diagnostics’ platform relies on fragmentomics – the discovery that cancer cells are more chaotic than normal cells and, when they die, leave behind tell\-tale patterns and characteristics of cell\-free DNA (cfDNA) fragments. FirstLook Lung, for individuals eligible for lung cancer screening, is DELFI Diagnostics’ first laboratory\-developed screening test and can be part of routine blood work. FirstLook Lung uses millions of data points to reliably identify individuals who may have cancer detected through low\-dose CT, including early stage disease with a negative predictive value of 99\.8 percent. This test has not been cleared or approved by the FDA.

In our passionate pursuit to radically improve health outcomes, we serve humanity when we:

**Lead with Science, Anchor in Pragmatism**: We pioneer life\-changing science by ensuring quality, transparency, and rigor at all times. We explore thoughtfully, experiment smartly, and deliver impact with conviction.

**Build With \& For All**: We embrace diverse backgrounds to innovate and achieve together. We are not just building a product \- we aim to disrupt the path of cancer for all \- no matter geography or socioeconomic class

**Put We over I**: We are a home for high\-performing people. Through teamwork, we build collective intelligence. Each of us wins when those we serve and those who serve with us\-win. We show up with empathy, humility, and integrity at every step of the journey.

jobs.description:
Job Overview
  
  

You are invited to apply for the position of Operations Manager for the Detector Microfabrication Facility (DMF) in the Fundamental Physics Directorate (FPD) at SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory. The Operations Manager is responsible for directing the operation of the DMF cleanroom and supporting technical systems (e.g. deposition and fabrication tools, tool utilities, metrology laboratory) to enable the fabrication of state\-of\-the\-art superconducting microelectronics devices in the DMF to support SLAC’s scientific mission. To fulfill this responsibility the Operations Manager has the authority to:
  
  

Manage the DMF and associated external facilities.
  
  

Hire and manage the DMF staff including engineers and technicians.
  
  

Implement the process controls, operations procedures, and training standards for all DMF work.
  
  

Manage the allocation of DMF resources.
  
  

Work with the DMF Director and their team to ensure DMF serves the needs of its users
  
  

The Detector Microfabrication Facility (DMF) is an ISO\-5 cleanroom with a dedicated toolset for the R\&D and at\-scale production of superconducting devices and sensors with high uniformity, complexity, yield, and reproducibility. In addition to a specialized toolset on 150mm wafers, the DMF also includes necessary capabilities for post\-fabrication metrology, room\-temperature and cryogenic characterization, and validation of functionality and performance of devices produced at the DMF. The facility is envisioned to support DOE mission science by enabling collaborative research across universities, labs and industry in quantum information science and fundamental physics. The DMF is managed by the Fundamental Physics Directorate (FPD). The FPD brings together scientists and technologies that support national priorities in particle physics, astrophysics and cosmology to explore the basic particles and forces that knit the cosmos together. As a key member of the DMF management team, you will report to the DMF Director.
  
  

**Your specific responsibilities will include:**  

Management of all operations in the Detector Microfabrication Facility; cleanroom, tool suite, and metrology lab.
  
  

Support of the scientific user base in optimizing device fabrication, while maintaining stringent standards for core process stability and purity.
  
  

Support of SLAC leadership in the strategic and financial planning for the DMF.
  
  

Scheduling and coordination all work in the DMF.
  
  

Management of the online portal(s) for tool status and reserving/logging of tool usage and operator hours.
  
  

Hiring and management of the DMF core team (tool engineers, process engineers and technicians). Work with the Scientific Direction to help build a team of device scientists to complement the operations team.
  
  

Building SLAC's values (excellence, integrity, collaboration, respect, and creativity), and safety into every aspect of the DMF core team’s work and culture.
  
  

Engagement of matrixed SLAC staff or external contracted resources where appropriate to augment DMF core staff.
  
  

Assuring that all DMF operations are performed safely and in compliance with SLAC, Stanford, and Government requirements and regulations, in collaboration with SLAC Environment, Safety \& Health (ESH) staff.
  
  

Establish and communicate to staff and users the safety protocols for use of the facility and its tools, coordinating with ESH as necessary.
  
  

Establish the qualifications and training requirements for staff and users to access and work in the DMF facility.
  
  

Develop and manage the DMF\-specific staff and user training.
  
  

Plan tool acceptance activities and develop procedures for tool startup and commissioning when new tools are introduced to the facility. Maintain standard operating procedures for facility tools including deposition, etching, lithography and metrology tools and wet benches.
  
  

Plan and manage the maintenance of DMF tools (e.g., lithography, etching, deposition, wet benches, SRDs) coordinating preventative maintenance schedules and servicing. Procure maintenance contracts for the major fabrication tools.
  
  

Plan and manage the maintenance of DMF subsystems (e.g., ultra\-pure water, process vacuum, utility nitrogen, acid waste neutralization) coordinating preventative maintenance schedules and servicing. Coordinate with Facilities \& Operations (F\&O) on the development and execution of regular cleanroom maintenance of F\&O\-managed systems and utilities. Procure maintenance contracts where appropriate.
  
  

Plan and manage the maintenance of DMF metrology tools (e.g., dilution refrigerator) coordinating preventative maintenance schedules and servicing. Procure maintenance contracts where appropriate.
  
  

Maintain cleanroom materials catalogs and documentation and establish protocols for safe handling of materials and waste; maintain stock of common cleanroom supplies and consumables.
  
  

**To be successful in this position you will bring:**  

Demonstrated excellence in leading disciplined operations at a research cleanroom facility.
  
  

Bachelor’s degree with 8 years of relevant experience in a science or engineering discipline relevant to the DMF’s mission in performing the above listed duties.
  
  

Experience fostering an environment that cultivates innovation and groundbreaking R\&D while simultaneously ensuring delivery to sponsors and projects.
  
  

Experience working in an environment dedicated to quality, safety and customer service.
  
  

Ability to negotiate mutually beneficial outcomes, manage conflict, and motivate others to action.
  
  

Verbal and written communication skills to effectively build and maintain working partnerships with internal and external stakeholders – including Stanford University, the Department of Energy, the DOE National Lab complex, and private industry leaders.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
In the journey of life, your career should make a difference.


At Inizio Evoke, we come together—to do the best work, in the best possible place. We're all in. Because it's everyone's role to make health more human™.


**About the Role**


We're looking for a Senior Program Manager to run the operating rhythm of Operatev — Inizio Evoke's enterprise AI platform — from the inside out.


This is a high\-visibility, cross\-functional role responsible for keeping the program on schedule and its status transparent. You'll own the connective tissue: sequencing work across Product, Development, Change \& Enablement, Support, Operations, Business Transformation, and Commercialization so that nothing blocks on an unowned handoff and everyone is working from the same picture of where things stand.


You will sit at the center of a program that is building and rolling out a platform to 1,200 people. That means competing priorities, real dependencies, and a delivery pace that doesn't slow down. You will bring strong program management fundamentals in a product development environment, thrive on clarity and structure, and know how to translate complex cross\-functional realities into reporting that actually drives decisions.


This is a remote role reporting to the Program Lead.

  



**What You'll Do:**


***Own Cross\-Team Sequencing***


* Map dependencies across functions — what depends on what, in what order — and monitor progress against that sequence
* Ensure handoffs are owned, surface unresolved blockers early, and drive items to closure or escalation
* Maintain visibility into the implications of sequencing decisions for Product, Development, and all downstream functions

***Run the Quarterly Planning Cycle***


* Gather functional inputs across all workstreams
* Facilitate commitment\-setting and document outcomes
* Translate quarterly commitments into trackable milestones and hold functions accountable to them

***Track Program Resourcing***


* Maintain visibility into where capacity is going against what's committed and manage the program's calendar to proactively address capacity challenges
* Surface trends and anomalies to program leadership before they become problems
* Oversee recruitment process, meeting with talent acquisition for updates and ensuring timely progress through stakeholder participation

***Set and Hold Stage Gate Standards***


* Define the gates work passes through and what evidence clears each one
* Keep functional cadences in sync without taking over internal functional processes (sprint practices, capability lifecycle, etc.)

***Run Delivery Forums***


* Facilitate the weekly initiative update and risk review
* Maintain the risk register and drive items to resolution or escalation
* Track progress against quarterly commitments and hold the reporting cadence

***Define Reporting Standards***


* Establish and maintain the data taxonomy that governs how each function reports its metrics
* Ensure functional outputs roll into one consistent program\-level picture rather than competing narratives

***Own Executive Reporting***


* Prepare and deliver the synthesized program view for executive and steering committee audiences
* Surface where delivery reality constrains what's being asked — clearly and with context

  

**What You'll Bring:**


* 7\+ years of experience in program management, delivery management, or PMO leadership — ideally within a technology platform, transformation, or product delivery context
* Experience running formal planning cycles (quarterly or release\-based) and translating outputs into trackable commitments
* Track record of building and maintaining executive\-level reporting that is trusted and acted on
* Comfortable managing budget and resource visibility — not ownership, but accurate tracking and surfacing of variance
* Background in professional services, agency, consulting, or regulated industry preferred (healthcare, life sciences, or similar)

***Skills***

**Overview**
------------


Intuit's CTREC organization (Cybersecurity, Trust \& Safety, Risk, Enterprise Systems and Compliance) protects the company and powers the technology experiences of our global workforce. We're looking for a Senior Change Manager to own organizational change management (OCM) delivery and adoption strategy for CTREC's most critical programs — the changes that touch every Intuit employee, from security protocols to enterprise systems to employee\-experience technology.  

This is a hands\-on leadership role, not an advisory one. You will craft the change strategy for each program and personally execute every piece of it — communications across channels, enablement content, stakeholder engagement, and adoption measurement. There is no separate design or communications team behind you, and no runway to learn the discipline on the job. Skilled, self\-directed OCM leadership is essential to adoption success from day one.

You'll operate as part of the Change COE — the team that designs the human layer around technology change so employees don't just get access to something new; they understand it, want it, and can use it well. The COE matches its response to the size and risk of each change: it Drives the highest\-impact changes end to end, Supports moderate ones by contributing strategy while the owning team executes, and Consults as the fast expert check on lower\-risk changes. * Develop and implement change management tools and processes that accelerate change activities, ensure a consistent change experience, and standardize communication approaches across programs.
* Monitor employee feedback channels to address questions and gauge sentiment on Security change initiatives, feeding insights back into program decisions.
* Measure adoption, gather feedback, and iterate — closing the loop between user sentiment and program decisions.

* 7\+ years of change management experience supporting large, multi\-site enterprise implementations of HR, IT service, Security, or employee\-experience technology.

* A track record of creative, low\-friction adoption solutions that reached and activated distributed audiences — including building user trust in automation acting on their behalf.
* AI platform fluency — you use AI tools and platforms fluently in your own work (research, content development, analysis) and can guide others through AI\-driven change.

**Position Overview:**


The Program Manager leads high\-quality after\-school programming that empowers youth, supports families, and aligns with A.S.E.S. and ELOP standards. This role oversees program operations, staff supervision, and partnerships with schools and community organizations to create a safe, engaging, and outcome\-driven environment.


Responsible for staff development, program evaluation, and resource management, the Program Manager ensures that youth receive enriching experiences that prepare them for success. By fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and strong community engagement, this role plays a key part in advancing BGCSL’s mission to inspire and empower all young people to reach their full potential.

**Our Values in Action:**

**Transformative Leadership:** We aspire to transform possibilities into probabilities. By embodying emotional intelligence, vulnerability, and empathy, we foster positive change with humility, authenticity, and continuous self\-improvement.

* ***What that looks like in this role:***Leading with empathy, self\-awareness, and a commitment to continuous growth, creating an environment where staff feel supported, empowered, and confident in their roles. Encouraging a culture of learning, collaboration, and adaptability while investing in staff development to cultivate future leaders. Ensuring alignment with organizational values by guiding youth enrichment programming, child supervision, and family engagement. Providing clear direction, feedback, and support to staff, reinforcing high standards for program quality and professionalism.

**Resilience:** We approach every situation with a growth mindset, demonstrating flexibility and courage, reframing challenges as opportunities. We acknowledge our current state, embrace change, and adapt as needed, maintaining a solutions\-oriented approach throughout our growth journey.

* ***What that looks like in this role:***Navigating daily challenges such as staffing changes, behavior management, and program logistics with flexibility and a solutions\-focused mindset. Modeling perseverance and adaptability for both staff and students, ensuring program goals remain the priority despite obstacles. Creating a structured yet responsive environment where challenges become opportunities for learning and growth. Maintaining a focus on continuous improvement, using data, feedback, and site observations to enhance program effectiveness.

**Youth Centered Approach:** Every organizational action or maneuver is designed to directly impact and benefit the youth we serve. We value and prioritize the youth perspective, making decisions with a focus on their needs and well\-being, rather than adult convenience.

* ***What that looks like in this role:*** Prioritizing student well\-being and success by ensuring that curriculum, enrichment activities, and behavior support strategies are designed to meet the diverse needs of youth. jobs.title: Night Quality Assurance Manager
jobs.description:
City Wide Facility Solutions is the nation's leading management company in the building maintenance industry, providing facility solutions to commercial properties across the South Bay and Santa Cruz areas. We are seeking a detail\-oriented Night Quality Assurance Manager to join our team part\-time.


City Wide manages facility services through a network of Independent Contractors (ICs) — independent businesses that employ their own crews. As Night Quality Assurance Manager, you are City Wide's quality\-assurance and contract\-compliance representative in the field after hours. You visit client buildings on a nightly route, inspect completed work against each account's scope of work, document what you find, and communicate directly with the IC's owner or authorized representative so any deficiency gets corrected quickly. You are the reason our clients walk into a spotless facility every morning.


Two requirements are essential for this role:

* **Fully bilingual in English and Spanish.** This is a business necessity — you will communicate with Spanish\-speaking Independent Contractor representatives on site and report to English\-speaking clients and City Wide management on the same shift.
* **Hands\-on commercial janitorial knowledge.** You need to know the work, the chemicals, and the equipment well enough to evaluate whether it was performed to specification.

 **Schedule \& Pay**

* Approximately 20 hours per week, generally 4 hours a night, 5 nights a week (Monday–Friday) Flexible
* Flexible schedule — start times and route order are flexible and set collaboratively based on client access windows and your availability. Shifts typically begin between 6:00 PM and 8:00 PM.
* Pay range: $30\.00 – $33\.00 per hour, depending on experience. This is the good\-faith pay scale for this position.

* Verify that contracted deliverables were completed on schedule and to specification, and confirm follow\-up on any prior deficiency

* Ensure City Wide's own compliance with client site access, safety, and security procedures

 **Preferred**

* Strong planning and organizational skills with a sharp eye for detail
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

 **Physical Requirements**

jobs.title: Consumer Device Safety & Risk Operations Specialist, User Safety & Risk Operations
jobs.description:
Trust \& Safety \- San Francisco

  


**About the Team**


At OpenAIs of misuse. We operate at the front line of real\-world safety and risk management, translating user and operational signals into timely decisions, effective interventions, and improvements to our systems.


This role sits on a team focused on building operational capacity for new, ambiguous, and fast\-moving areas of work. The team defines what needs to be built, creates the operating model to support it, and works with partner teams to make the work scalable and durable over time.


**About the Role**


We are seeking a Device Safety \& Risk Operations Specialist to build the safety operating model for a new category of consumer hardware. This is a senior individual\-contributor role for someone who can turn emerging product risks and incomplete requirements into practical workflows, controls, launch plans, and durable systems.


You will define how product\-safety incidents, critical escalations, regulated cases, and privacy\-sensitive issues should be identified, investigated, escalated, resolved, and learned from. You will also establish operational requirements for case management, data access, decision logging, quality assurance, monitoring, and cross\-functional response. You will stand up priority workflows through launch and early operations, then help transition them into durable homes across USRO and partner teams.


The right person combines deep operational judgment with strong technical and hardware product fluency. They can move from executive\-level risk framing to detailed workflow design, tabletop exercises, launch readiness, frontline guidance, and post\-launch improvement.


Location / work model: San Francisco, CA; hybrid, 3 days/week in\-office.


Please note: This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning material. Strong discretion, judgment, and resilience are essential.

  

  

**In This Role, You Will:**


* Build the end\-to\-end safety and risk operating model for new consumer hardware, from early requirements through launch and early\-life operations.
* Define incident taxonomies, severity levels, decision rights, escalation criteria, response pathways, and closure standards.
* Develop operational playbooks for product\-safety incidents, critical escalations, safety advisories, corrective actions, and other high\-risk events.
* Design workflows for regulated and privacy\-sensitive cases, including restricted handling, evidence requirements, auditability, and partner escalation.
* Translate safety and operational needs into requirements for tooling, case management, data access, monitoring, logging, and automation.
* Establish clear ownership boundaries across Product, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Product Policy, Support, Product Quality, and other operational partners.

**About the Team**


Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) is foundational to Security delivering mission outcomes at OpenAI. jobs.description:

Lyft Business is changing the way companies, brands, and organizations alike leverage the Lyft platform to redefine the way they operate. We are solving big problems and meeting the needs of our clients and their people, from employees to customers and students to patients, in a whole new way. As an Account Manager, Automotive on the Lyft Business team, you'll help Automotive Dealerships get more out of Lyft and its solutions after the sale. You'll join a talented team focused on one thing: using technology and Lyft's network of drivers to improve transportation for a company's customers and employees. We're looking for smart, ambitious individuals with account management experience who want to transform the way people move around and succeed in a fast moving environment.


**Responsibilities:**
---------------------


* Own a book of existing dealership accounts, with responsibility for retention, adoption, and revenue growth
* Build and manage an expansion pipeline within your accounts by developing trusted client relationships from first renewal conversation to signed expansion
* Accurately forecast, track, and manage revenue, renewals, and churn risk with multiple systems and tools (Salesforce, Claude, Gemini, Outreach, Google Suite, Mode, and Tableau)
* Achieve quarterly retention and net revenue growth targets
* Running quarterly business reviews, monitoring account usage and health data, and re\-engaging dormant users and rooftops

* Establish collaborative relationships with Lyft Business customers and demonstrate Lyft value to client\-focused initiatives

* Liaise with internal stakeholders, including Operations, Support, and Product, to resolve client issues and drive the effectiveness of account initiatives
* Represent Lyft at marketing and trade show events
* Travel up to 20% of the time for meetings and visits to client locations
* Reports directly to the Manager of Automotive Sales

---------------


* 2\+ years of B2B account management, customer success, or renewals experience carrying a retention or growth number (SaaS API integration, ad\-tech, or transportation a plus)
* Proficiency with Salesforce or similar CRM, AI tooling, and a knack for learning new sales tech
* A passion for mobility, the auto industry, or simply making transportation and logistics easy
* Experience owning the post\-sale lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, renewal, objection\-handling, and upsell
* Comfort using usage and performance data to identify risk and surface growth opportunities
* Demonstrated success in exceeding retention or growth targets
* Excellent communication skills \- A big part of the role is talking to clients on the phone and in\-person
* Possess a competitive spirit and are excited to prove not to others, but to yourself, what you are capable of
* High energy, you like to get things done and make things happen
* Self starter, loves to win, and grow professionally
* Ambitious and not afraid of putting yourself out there

-------------


* Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
* Mental health benefits
* Family building benefits
* Child care and pet benefits
* 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
