Security \- San Francisco

  


**About the Team**


OpenAI’s Governance, Risk, and Compliance team helps ensure security and privacy are grounded in how our products and systems actually operate. Assurance Operations partners with Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, Privacy, and Legal to make controls provable, risk decisions explicit, and audit readiness a result of well\-designed systems.


**About the Role**


We are hiring a technical, product\-minded GRC builder who can own consequential audits while improving the control and evidence systems behind them. You will build a reusable common control framework, use Codex to automate assurance work, validate changing system scope, and turn repeated audit friction into measurable improvements. We are looking for someone who questions inherited assumptions, solves novel problems creatively, works closely with engineers, and makes the next audit easier by improving the underlying system.


**You’ll be responsible for:**


* Lead external, internal, customer, and certification audit work from scoping through evidence review, fieldwork, remediation, and closeout.
* Build a common control framework linking risk, control intent, implementation, owner, system, environment, evidence, and applicable frameworks.
* Validate actual scope and ownership instead of assuming last year's controls, product boundaries, or evidence remain accurate.
* Use Codex to build and test evidence checks, control mappings, request triage, owner workflows, monitoring, and remediation reporting.
* Partner with engineers on cloud architecture, identity, logging, data flows, software changes, vulnerabilities, and control effectiveness.
* Design maintainable, permission\-aware tools that preserve source provenance, human review, and evidence integrity.
* Reduce repeated requests and operational burden for control owners through measurable workflow improvements.
* Define roadmaps, decision rights, milestones, success metrics, and clear cross\-functional escalations.

**We’re looking for someone with:**


* Direct ownership of meaningful audit, security, customer\-assurance, or regulatory outcomes.
* Practical knowledge of control design, evidence, testing, operating effectiveness, and remediation.
* Technical fluency across cloud systems, identity, logging, APIs, data flows, and system boundaries.
* Ability to use Codex or comparable AI\-assisted development tools to build, run, inspect, and test a working solution.
* Experience using code, SQL, APIs, structured data, automation, or data workflows to solve an operational problem.
* Ability to design reusable cross\-framework controls without erasing framework\-specific test and evidence requirements.
* First\-principles curiosity, creative problem solving, intellectual humility, and the ability to update when facts change.
* Product and program judgment: define the user, scope, milestones, ownership, adoption, and measurable outcome.

jobs.description:
Finance \- San Francisco

  


**About the Team**


OpenAI’s Central Procurement – Hardware Operations team is building scalable, AI\-enabled operating foundations for a rapidly growing hardware footprint. We help the business move quickly while maintaining the data quality and controls needed to manage financial and operational risk responsibly.


As OpenAI scales across R\&D, new\-product introduction, manufacturing, and third\-party custody models, we are building the foundations to absorb complexity without adding unnecessary friction. That means establishing practical standards, strengthening discipline where it matters, using AI thoughtfully, and continuously improving how teams manage hardware operations.


**About the Role**


We are hiring an Asset Compliance Program Lead to establish the cross\-business framework that gives OpenAI reliable lifecycle visibility over hardware\-related financial assets and capital equipment. You will define the controls, systems roadmap, and evidence practices needed to manage those assets within OpenAI’s financial\-control scope.


This is a senior individual\-contributor role in Central Procurement – Hardware Operations within Finance. Distinct from sourcing and transaction execution, you will partner with hardware business units, Accounting, Financial Risk Management, Procurement, contract manufacturers, and other third\-party custodians to deploy practical operating mechanisms. These mechanisms will connect how assets are purchased, built, received, moved, held, verified, and retired with the ownership, data, reporting, and evidence needed for financial governance.


The role covers those assets regardless of location or custody, including manufacturing equipment and tooling, supplier\- and contract\-manufacturer\-held assets, leased assets, and other third\-party\-held equipment.


You will stay close to the operational details—how assets move, where records diverge, which controls are not working, and where evidence is incomplete—and use that view to strengthen processes, accountability, and systems without compromising speed or flexibility.


**In this role, you will:**


* Design and scale the end\-to\-end asset\-compliance operating model across acquisition and capitalization, custody and location tracking, transfers, lifecycle events, inventory and verification, impairment or retirement, and audit\-evidence retention.

jobs.title: Case Manager Housing Specialist - Housing Program 625
jobs.description:
**Canyon Vista is a 57 unit transitional and permanent supportive housing (PSH) program serving adults in San Mateo County with serious mental illness. Telecare will provide onsite case management, housing stabilization and rehabilitative services to tenants living in transitional and PSH units. Services onsite will be available 24 hours a day, 7 days per week.**

  


**POSITION SUMMARY**  

Under direct supervision, serves as a primary support and case manager for individuals with mental illness and other cooccurring disorders by assisting them to live as independently as possible in their chosen community.

  


**Shifts Available:**



Full\-Time \| AM \| Shifts: 7:00 AM \- 3:30 PM \| Days: Wednesday \- Saturday



Expected starting wage is $29\.37\. The full wage range goes up to $max. This position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement and is subject to union membership requirements upon hire. Telecare applies geographic differentials to its pay ranges. The pay range assigned to this role will be based on the geographic location from which the role is performed. Starting pay is commensurate with relevant experience above the minimum requirements.

  


**QUALIFICATIONS**


**Required:**


* + High School Graduation or G.E.D. equivalent and three (3\) years of direct services in mental health or community services; or Associate's degree and two (2\) years of experience; or Bachelor's degree in Social Services
* Must possess at least 1 year of direct service experience providing assistance as a Housing Specialist
* Sensitivity to multi\-cultural populations and issues
* Must be at least 18 years of age
* Must be CPR, Crisis Prevention Institute (CPI), and First Aid certified on date of employment or within 60 days of employment and maintain current certification throughout employment
* All opportunities at Telecare are contingent upon successful completion and receipt of acceptable results of the applicable post\-offer physical examination, 2\-step PPD test for tuberculosis, acceptable criminal background clearances, excluded party sanctions, and degree or license verification. If the position requires driving, valid driver license, a motor vehicle clearance, and proof of auto insurance is required at time of employment and must be maintained throughout employment. Additional regulatory, contractual or local requirements may apply.

  


**Preferred:**


* Four (4\) years' experience in a mental health setting
* Experience providing intensive case management and/or intensive community supports using psychiatric rehabilitation concepts
* Experience in a mental health setting, outpatient clinic, or community mental health service
* Knowledge of Housing Resources in local community

  


**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**


* Demonstrates the Telecare mission, purpose, values, and beliefs in everyday language and contact with internal and external stakeholders
* Collaborates with members served to create Recovery Plan goals and ensure all services described in the Recovery Plan are provided
* Consistent with area of expertise, provides specialized services and interventions related to housing, including thematic groups, evidence\-based practices, and collaboration with external agencies and resources
* Facilitates groups according to the needs and interests of members served especially related to education regarding Housing needs and maintenance
* Provides appropriate interventions in crisis situations
* On a rotating basis, performs officer of the day functions for both wellness, duty and stand by duty tasks
* Collects required data and completes required documentation
* Coordinates transitions to lower levels of care
* Maintains awareness of community resources and assists members served in appropriate use of community resources
* Assists members served with all needs, including Activities of Daily Living
* Assists members served in making and getting to essential appointments
* Assists and advocates for members served in obtaining appropriate benefits; provide representative payee services
* Ensures that members served understand their legal status and rights
* Helps members served achieve greater independence and autonomy
* Safeguards confidentiality; adheres to HIPAA policies
* Provides wraparound services that encompass whole person care
* Provides transportation when needed and appropriate and linkage to community resources
* If employed at inpatient program, must assist with restraint of members served in the event of assaultive behavior and pass assault crisis/crisis prevention training
* If employed at outpatient program, must evade members served in the event of assaultive behavior and pass assault crisis/crisis prevention training
* Provide and document quality and quantity of direct services as required by program standards

  



Duties and responsibilities may be added, deleted, and/or changed at the discretion of management.

  


**SKILLS**


* Thorough understanding of the rights of members served and relevant legal processes
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Good computer/technology skills
* Ability to assess safety risks
* Ability to easily build rapport, maintain engagement with members served, and hold hope in the face of adversity
* Excellent driving skills
* Knowledge of basic medical and psychiatric terminology
* Within two {2} months of employment, ability to apply financial requirements for billing and learn billing codes

  


**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**



The physical demands here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.



The employee is occasionally required to stand, twist, squat, kneel, push, pull, lift, and carry items weighing 25 pounds or less as well as to frequently sit, walk, reach, bend, and do simple and power grasping. The position requires driving and frequent hazardous exposure (blood borne pathogens, hospital waste, chemicals, and infections}.

jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------


**Securing Travel, Protecting People** \- At the Transportation Security Administration, you will serve in a high\-stakes environment to safeguard the American way of life. In cities across the country, you would secure airports, seaports, railroads, highways, and/or public transit systems, thus protecting America's transportation infrastructure and ensuring freedom of movement for people and commerce.


Learn more about this agency


  
**This job is open to**
-----------------------


### **The public**


U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.
### **Clarification from the agency**


Open to All U.S. Citizens and U.S. Nationals


  
**Duties**
----------


This Training Manager position is located at **San Francisco International Airport (SFO)**, Transportation Security Administration, Department of Homeland Security (DHS). Duties include but are not limited to:


* Planning and ensuring development and implementation of training schedules to meet TSA training and certification goals; developing the airport's annual training plan.
* Ensuring all required Transportation Security Officer (TSO) training is coordinated, conducted, and accomplished at hub and/or spoke airports under your assigned jurisdiction.
* Briefing the FSD and other management staff regarding the training status of the workforce.
* Coordinating the training of Security Training Instructors (STI) and Assistant Training Instructors (ATI) to ensure the staff is fully capable and prepared to instruct.
* Coordinating the scheduling of STI/ATI and Training Technicians (TT) with the Assistant Federal Security Director of Screening and the
* Scheduling Operations Officer to ensure the full scope of work requirements are met.
* Disseminating updates and management decisions that impact training.
* Ensuring training compliance as required by the Aviation and Transportation Security Act (ATSA), TSA Management Directives and local procedures.
* Evaluating training programs to determine staff, equipment and other critical resource needs; working with appropriate organizational entities to acquire such resources.
* Facilitating and coordinating all training for the airport including providing support for FSD staff training and partnering with special programs training instructors (e.g., Behavioral Detection Officer (BDO), Bomb Appraisal Officer (BAO)) to ensure the development and delivery of a comprehensive and cohesive training program.

Managerial duties include: Planning and communicating strategic vision and objectives; assigning tasks and responsibilities; setting priorities; monitoring and evaluating performance; coaching and developing employee capabilities; taking, recommending, or approving corrective/disciplinary actions, as appropriate.

----------------

* You must possess U.S. Citizenship or be a U.S. National.


* You must complete a favorable Background Investigation (BI).


* Selective Service registration is required.


**Supervisory/Managerial Trial Period Requirements:** Unless previously completed, you must satisfactorily complete a one\-year supervisory trial period to continue in this supervisory/managerial position.  

  

If you fail to meet the conditions of employment or any other pre\-employment requirements, such as missing any of the scheduled appointments, the hiring agency may rescind their tentative offer of employment.  

  

Applying to this announcement certifies that you give permission for TSA to share your application with others in DHS for similar positions.  

  

Any offers of employment made pursuant to this announcement will be consistent with all applicable authorities, including Presidential Memoranda, Executive Orders, interpretive U.S. Office of Management and Budget (OMB) and U.S. Office of Personnel Management (OPM) guidance, and Office of Management and Budget plans and policies concerning hiring. These authorities are subject to change.
### **Qualifications**


To qualify for the SV\-I Pay Band (equivalent to GS\-13\), you must have one year of specialized experience at the SV\-H or GS\-12 in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private sector. Specialized experience is defined as experience that has equipped you with the knowledge, skills and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position. Specialized experience is defined as:


* Serving as a liaison concerning training matters with management officials and other program offices;
* Assisting with briefing on training developmental issues;
* Assisting in providing advice to management officials about planning, directing, scheduling, evaluating and integrating training and professional development products; and
* Carrying out and improving training programs.

Credit for experience is given based on a 40\-hour workweek. Part\-time experience is credited on a part\-time ratio, i.e., working 20 hours per week for two months equals one month of experience. No additional credit is given for overtime.  

  

National Service Experience (i.e., volunteer experience): Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

jobs.title: Associate Program Manager - Packaging
jobs.description:
**ASSOCIATE PROGRAM MANAGER, PACKAGING**

**ABOUT KENDO**

Kendo Holdings, Inc. is a San Francisco\-based beauty brand developer and wholesaler owned by LVMH Moët Hennessy \- Louis Vuitton, the world’s largest luxury group. A play on the words “can do”, Kendo has become the hub of creativity and next generation beauty product development for global Sephora channels and selective retailers outside of Sephora.


Through original development, collaborations and acquisitions the Kendo stable of brands will always be creative, inspiring and innovative. A dynamic engine of speed, expertise and market\-savvy, the Kendo team continues to redefine the beauty industry through great product, great storytelling, great retail and direct\-to\-consumer partnerships. This shows up in everything we do and in what we stand for:


* “Can Do” Spirit: We work together to make our wildest dreams a reality: As entrepreneurs, we embrace optimism and find creative ways to reach our goals
* Advocacy, Diversity, and Inclusion: We recognize and celebrate the full spectrum of personal identities. We create safe spaces so everyone’s voice is heard. We listen with humility and act with courage.
* Storytelling: We tell authentic stories like no, one else. It’s our key to inspire trust and build relationships, rallying, our people, partners, and consumers around our brands.
* Resilience: We embrace challenges as opportunities. Change is ever\- constant, and agility is our strength.
Product Excellence: We put the consumers first: We constantly raise the bar to create products of the highest quality that everyone just has to have.  
* 

The salary range for this position is $81,900 \- $94,300 per year. Offered salary is dependent upon experience and San Francisco location. This is a hybrid role based in our downtown San Francisco office – Tues through Thursday in\-office, with Monday and Friday remote.


Kendo Total Rewards offerings also include an annual bonus and a comprehensive benefits package including: medical, dental and vision insurance, flex paid time off program, parental leave, employee discount/perks, a retirement plan with employer contributions, Summer Fridays, opportunity to work from anywhere for two weeks during the calendar year and December wellness/shutdown week for applicable positions.  



The Kendo house of brands currently includes: Fenty Beauty, Fenty Skin, Fenty Eau de Parfum, Fenty Hair, Ole Henriksen, Lip Lab.  



**SUMMARY**

Independent self\-starter responsible for managing the creative development of packaging artwork for two Kendo brands. Responsible for ensuring on\-time delivery of packaging artwork \& deliverables throughout the creative process, from concept development through final execution.  



**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Manages packaging creation and delivery process (70%):**

* Assist in bi\-weekly status meeting, keep team leads informed and discuss status for each project while establishing clear next steps resolving blocks that impede progress
* Upload and monitor individual project timelines through Asana
* Actively monitor schedules and follow\-up on internal copy/layout/mechanical due dates to ensure teams meet deadlines throughout lifespan of each artwork piece
* Follow up with team leads for missing packaging information (e.g., dielines, ingredient lists, copy, translations, UPCs, fill weight, etc.). Add dielines, ingredient lists, fill weights, UPCs to server.
* Work directly with Regulatory \& Compliance team to track and confirm EU artwork approval
* Communicate projects to Production Artists and outline daily priorities
* Follow up on questions/approvals with internal teams
* Collaborate with Production Artist to confirm artwork releases and approvals of samples
* Actively participate in weekly Product Development and Operation meetings
* Track comp requests for photo shoots, Market Week, etc.

**Manage artwork routing process (30%):**

* Upload and route artwork in ProofHQ: ensure all questions are resolved and Production Artists are clear on changes
Review/Check\-in artwork from Production Artists  
* 

**REQUIREMENTS**

* BA degree or equivalent experience preferred
* 2\+ years of project management experience in retail or agency
* Proficient knowledge of computer programs: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Asana, Workfront Proof SmartSheets
* Retail or beauty experience preferred
* Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal
* Solid organizational skills, detail\-oriented; time management skills, ability to juggle priorities
* Strong relationship\-building skills; ability to work with a variety of people in various disciplines
* Ability to work in a very fast paced environment and meet very tight deadlines
* The drive to excel and succeed; self\-motivated
* Passion for beauty and retail

jobs.description:
**About Face Reality:**  

Face Reality Skincare was created with one goal: to give people clear skin for good. With over 50 million people experiencing the physical and emotional toll of acne each year in the US, we made it our mission to develop an effective way to achieve clear skin through our clinically verified Clear Skin MethodTM, an adaptive method combining in\-clinic treatments from certified skincare professionals, personalized at home product routines and lifestyle guidance. We are dedicated to giving not just real results but celebrating people and their skin at every part of their journey. **Our Core Values** **Integrity, Inclusion, Collaboration, Adaptability, Accessibility**  

Our supportive business model ensures that everyone has a clear path to success and growth. We foster an inclusive space in which people are valued for who they are and are encouraged to collaborate to see goals fully realized. Fostering an open, honest culture gives us the opportunity to achieve greater trust internally and externally. Remaining flexible and adaptive allows us to remain responsive to the ever\-changing world. Doing right, even if it is difficult, is of the utmost importance. **About the role**  

We are seeking an experienced and driven Associate Account Manager to join our team. In this role, you will focus on selling innovative solutions, driving B2B client (Acne Expert) productivity, and reviewing revenue performance to optimize business growth. You will play a key role in driving assortment decisions, maximizing product usage occasions, and ensuring the effective implementation of educational initiatives that support brand and protocol knowledge.  

The successful candidate will nurture strong relationships with Acne Experts, develop tailored sales strategies, and identify opportunities to grow revenue and enhance product utilization. This position involves calling on Acne Experts within a dedicated territory, following a structured call coverage schedule, and delivering exceptional customer service. As an Associate Account Manager, you will review performance metrics, provide insights on assortment strategies, and collaborate with Acne Experts to improve their business outcomes.

Four Seasons San Francisco

widget: Full time

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. A modern oasis in the city's most exciting location. Our goal is to attract only the most positive and passionate talent, those who are able to provide intuitive service, with a warm and friendly smile. jobs.title: Scaled Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI\-powered user interviews.


Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

  

The research industry is massive (\>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high\-cost services. That's our opportunity.

  

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.


The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.


We’re a tight\-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.


As a Scaled Customer Success Manager, you'll own adoption, retention, and growth across a mature portfolio of 100–200\+ accounts in our Scaled segment — and you'll build the systems that make covering a book that size possible.


You'll determine the right signals, automate analysis and follow\-ups, and design an operating model that gives customers an excellent experience. Roughly 70% of your time will be portfolio management; the other 30% will be building the infrastructure and process behind it — working closely with RevOps, Marketing, and Engineering.


This is a foundational hire. The health scoring, playbooks, and operating cadences you build will be the ones the team runs on for years, and you'll help define what "Scaled" means at Outset as the segment grows.

**Responsibilities**

* Own adoption, retention, and expansion outcomes across a portfolio of 100–200\+ Scaled accounts, from onboarding through renewal
* Keep usage and adoption high in a deliberately lower\-touch model — leverage programs, automation, and self\-service before reaching for a calendar invite
* Monitor account health and usage signals to catch risk and expansion opportunities early, and prioritize where your direct time actually changes the outcome
* Run renewals across a mixed model of actively managed and auto\-renewing accounts, partnering with our broader CS team on commercial approach
* Build and run one\-to\-many programs: onboarding cohorts, office hours, webinars, in\-product guidance, documentation, and templated success plans
* Develop our account health tracking methodology from the ground up — what signals matter, how they're weighted, how they trigger action, and how we know the scoring is predictive
* Partner cross\-functionally with RevOps, Marketing, and Engineering to build the infrastructure behind scaled CS: usage instrumentation, alerting, lifecycle triggers, and automated follow\-up
* Design the operational cadence for this segment: what regular communication looks like, how issues route to and from Product Support, and what escalation looks like. (Product Support owns ticket resolution. You own the process around it).
* Build reporting in Hex and with other AI tools that gives the business real visibility into Scaled segment health, adoption, and retention
* Translate portfolio\-wide patterns into prioritized input for Product

**Qualifications**

* 3–7 years in customer success, account management, CS operations, sales, or lifecycle/growth, including a high\-volume portfolio
* Experience building scaled or digital CS programs from scratch, or working as one of the first hires in a scaled CS role
* Technically fluent and self\-sufficient with data: product analytics and usage, pulling data with AI tools, and building tooling with AI
* Hands\-on with a modern GTM and support stack. Ours is Pylon, Hex, HubSpot, Salesforce, and Claude; we lean heavily on AI day to day and expect you to as well
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Series A/B/C or fast\-paced SaaS experience, with a proactive, ownership\-driven approach to ambiguity

**Nice to have**

* Experience defining or re\-segmenting a customer base, or standing up a support model for a new segment
* Background in customer marketing, growth, or RevOps
* Familiarity with research operations or market research


Compensation Range: $130K \- $180K

jobs.title: Lead, Channel Enablement
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**


‎


Commercial Organization \| GTM Enablement  

Reports to: Director, GTM Enablement  

  

The Lead, Channel Enablement owns the enablement strategy and infrastructure that helps Castlight\-powered solutions get sold effectively through our channel ecosystem, including health plans, strategic partners, resellers, and Marketplace relationships.  

  

This role is the Commercial owner of the second sale enablement motion and the connective tissue across Castlight, our partners, and the teams responsible for bringing our solutions to market. The Lead builds the training, demos, tools, and repeatable programs that allow partner sellers and Castlight teams to confidently position, demonstrate, and sell Castlight\-powered solutions at scale.  

  

The role also owns the core demo infrastructure supporting channel selling, ensuring our Figma environments, screen libraries, and partner\-specific experiences stay current as the product evolves.
‎

**How will you make an impact \& Requirements**


‎

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**Channel \& Partner Enablement**
---------------------------------

* Build and own the channel enablement strategy across health plans, strategic partners, resellers, and Marketplace partners.
* Develop scalable enablement programs that help partner sellers understand the buyer problem, articulate the Castlight value proposition, demonstrate the solution, and advance opportunities.
* Create partner\-ready training programs, playbooks, talk tracks, FAQs, objection handling, templates, and selling tools using Product Marketing's approved positioning and messaging.
* Partner with Strategic Partnerships to build tailored enablement programs based on partner type, commercial model, seller audience, and go\-to\-market motion.
* Support the launch and ongoing readiness of new partner relationships and Castlight\-powered offerings.

**Second Sale Enablement**
--------------------------

* Own the enablement framework for the second sale motion across health plan and partner channels.

* Prepare Castlight Commercial and Client teams for the transition of second sale execution to Client CSMs by September 30\.

--------------------------------

* Own the core demo environments supporting health plan, partner, reseller, and second sale motions.
* Build and maintain Figma\-based demos, screen libraries, reusable components, and partner\-specific demo experiences.
* Maintain demo environments as products, capabilities, positioning, and user experiences evolve.
* Lead Nova conversions across the existing channel book and establish the standards for new partner implementations.
* Manage partner access to demo environments and establish clear governance around version control, usage, and updates.
* Coordinate external design or Figma resources as needed to maintain and scale the demo platform.

**Cross\-Functional Enablement**

This role operates across several teams, with clear ownership boundaries:

**Product Marketing** owns core positioning, messaging architecture, value propositions, competitive strategy, and master marketing assets.

**Channel Enablement** turns that strategy into training, demos, playbooks, tools, certification, and scalable seller experiences.

**Strategic Partnerships** owns partner strategy, relationships, commercial agreements, partner performance, and escalations.

* New partners can move from agreement to seller readiness through a repeatable enablement process.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***


The Pharmacy Fraud Program Manager is a member of the Special Investigations Unit responsible for detecting, validating, and investigating suspected fraudulent activity within the pharmacy benefit — including prescribing, dispensing, and pharmacy claims activity — across a wide range of internal and external data sources. This role centers on rigorous data validation — reconciling, cross\-referencing, and stress\-testing information drawn from numerous systems to confirm accuracy, surface inconsistencies, and build defensible investigative findings.


The ideal candidate pairs a deeply inquisitive, investigative mindset with strong analytical discipline and brings genuine pharmacy depth: fluency with pharmacy claims data and pharmacy benefit operations, including NCPDP claim fields, NDCs, quantity and days supply logic, formulary and prior authorization concepts, and prescriber and pharmacy identifiers (NPI, DEA, state license), together with a working knowledge of the regulatory framework governing pharmacy fraud, waste, and abuse.


They are fluent in recognizing pharmacy fraud triggers and red flags — prescribing and dispensing outliers, controlled substance and overutilization patterns, and pharmacy billing schemes — and they actively leverage AI\-assisted detection and validation tools to scale their analysis, prioritize cases, and reduce false positives. This person is comfortable asking hard questions, following the data wherever it leads, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable conclusions.


In addition to the core responsibilities of the Fraud Program Manager role, this position serves as the primary owner of the CFWA relationship with our pharmacy benefit manager, coordinating referrals, reporting, and oversight activities between the organization and CVS. This person will work side by side with the Fraud Program Manager on overall fraud detection and scheme identification.

***Your responsibilities and impact will include:***

**CFWA Relationship Management — CVS**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and relationship owner for the CFWA program with CVS, managing day\-to\-day coordination, escalations, and information exchange.
* Manage the intake, routing, and disposition of CFWA referrals to and from CVS, tracking each referral through resolution and ensuring turnaround times and documentation standards are met.

* Monitor CVS performance against contractual, delegated, and regulatory FWA obligations; identify gaps, request corrective action, and escalate deficiencies to compliance and leadership.
* Track pharmacy\-level actions performed by CVS under the PBM agreement — including pharmacy audits, prepayment review, claim edits, recoveries, and network termination — confirming that agreed actions were taken and applied correctly, and escalating where they were not.

**Data Validation \& Source Reconciliation**

* Validate, reconcile, and cross\-reference data drawn from numerous and disparate sources — pharmacy and medical claims systems, PBM data feeds, prior authorization and rejected\-claim data, eligibility and enrollment systems, prescriber and pharmacy provider files, third\-party databases, public records, watchlists, internal applications, and external vendor feeds.
* Identify discrepancies, anomalies, and inconsistencies across data sets — including NDC, quantity, days supply, DAW, prescriber NPI, DEA number, and dispensing pharmacy mismatches — and determine whether they indicate error, manipulation, or fraud.
* Establish and maintain data integrity standards for investigations, ensuring findings are accurate, complete, and defensible.
* Trace data lineage across internal systems and PBM\-supplied files, corroborating information against authoritative sources to confirm or refute investigative hypotheses.

**AI\-Assisted Detection \& Validation**

* Use AI\- and machine learning–driven detection tools to flag suspicious patterns, score risk, and surface high\-priority cases for review.
* Validate AI\-generated alerts and model outputs against source claims and clinical data, distinguishing genuine fraud indicators from false positives, data artifacts, and legitimate clinical variation.
* Provide structured feedback to analytics, vendor, and PBM partners to improve model accuracy, tuning, and rule logic over time.
* Stay current on emerging AI\-enabled fraud schemes (e.g., synthetic identities, deepfakes, generated prescriptions or prior authorization documentation, fraudulent e\-prescribing credentials) and adapt detection approaches accordingly.

**Pharmacy Fraud Detection, Triggers \& Red Flags**

* Apply deep knowledge of pharmacy fraud triggers, red flags, and typologies — including prescribing and dispensing patterns — to proactively identify suspicious activity before it escalates.
* Develop, refine, and document indicators and detection criteria based on emerging schemes and investigative learnings.
* Investigate referrals and self\-sourced leads, building complete case referrals supported by validated evidence.

**Position Overview**

Dabos is seeking a highly organized and commercially minded **Vendor Manager** to own and strengthen relationships with our supplier network. This role is responsible for vendor performance, pricing, sourcing, negotiations, product availability, and identifying opportunities to improve cost, lead times, and overall supplier performance.

The Vendor Manager will work closely with Sales, Account Management, Operations, and Customer Service to ensure Dabos has the right products, pricing, and supplier partnerships to support customer needs and continued business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and manage relationships with existing vendors and suppliers, serving as the primary point of contact for pricing, availability, lead times, and performance.
* Source and onboard new vendors to expand product capabilities, improve pricing, reduce lead times, and create supply\-chain alternatives.
* Negotiate product costs, payment terms, freight arrangements, minimum order quantities (MOQs), volume discounts, and other commercial terms.
* Regularly evaluate vendor pricing and identify opportunities to improve product margins and overall profitability.
* Obtain competitive quotes and conduct cost comparisons to ensure Dabos remains competitive in customer proposals and bids.
* Partner with Sales and Account Management teams to source products and develop solutions for customer opportunities.
* Manage vendor quote requests and ensure pricing and availability information is returned within required timelines.
* Monitor supplier performance across quality, pricing, fulfillment, responsiveness, and on\-time delivery.
* Proactively identify vendor or supply\-chain risks and develop alternative sourcing options when necessary.
* Maintain accurate vendor, product, pricing, lead\-time, and purchasing information within internal systems.
* Support large\-volume and recurring customer programs by developing purchasing strategies and forecasting future product requirements.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate purchasing and leverage Dabos overall spend to negotiate improved vendor terms.
* Work with Operations and Customer Service to resolve shortages, quality issues, shipping discrepancies, damaged products, and other vendor\-related escalations.
* Develop and maintain a strong network of domestic and international suppliers across multiple product categories.
* Track and report key vendor\-management metrics, including cost savings, margin improvement, supplier performance, sourcing turnaround time, and on\-time delivery.

**Qualifications**

* 3\+ years of experience in vendor management, procurement, purchasing, sourcing, category management, supply chain, or a related role.
* Demonstrated experience negotiating pricing and commercial terms with suppliers.
* Strong understanding of product costing, margins, freight, lead times, and purchasing fundamentals.
* Ability to manage multiple vendors, quotes, customer requests, and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to compare suppliers and make data\-driven purchasing decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where customer requirements and priorities can change quickly.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other business productivity tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within e\-commerce, distribution, wholesale, B2B sales, or promotional/product sourcing.
* Experience sourcing across a broad range of product categories.
* Experience working with both domestic and international manufacturers and suppliers.
* Familiarity with importing, freight, logistics, and supplier lead\-time management.
* Experience supporting RFPs, RFQs, large\-volume orders, or customized customer programs.

**Salary Range**

* $60,000\-$70,000

**What Success Looks Like**

* Success in this role means building a reliable and competitive vendor network that allows Dabos to respond quickly to customer opportunities while protecting profitability. The Vendor Manager will consistently improve supplier pricing and terms, reduce sourcing turnaround times, identify alternative suppliers before issues impact customers, and create stronger visibility into vendor performance.
* This position will help Dabos scale by transforming vendor management from a transactional purchasing function into a strategic capability that supports revenue growth, customer retention, and operational efficiency.

This position is accountable for operational monitoring and client relationship management. The Team Lead translates client needs into clear operational priorities, monitors key performance indicators, identifies risks and trends, and supports timely issue resolution to protect cash, A/R performance, and client satisfaction.


The role also provides operational mentorship to staff by reinforcing daily best practices, supporting training and performance efforts, and helping remove execution barriers. Success is measured by client retention, escalation volume, and core revenue cycle performance indicators.


These Goals and objectives are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed; employees will be required to perform other job\-related duties as required. Goals and objectives are subject to change.


All activities must be in compliance with Equal Employment Opportunity laws, HIPAA, ERISA and other regulations, as appropriate.

* **Operational Efficiency:** Lead tactical efforts to maximize operational efficiency and optimize reimbursement through standardized workflows, issue triage, and collaboration with cross\-functional partners.

**Client \& Stakeholder Relationship Management (Tactical)**

At Sysdig, we believe cloud security isn't a compromise \- it's a promise. From the start, our mission has been clear: to help organizations secure innovation in the cloud, the right way.

Culture matters here. We believe diversity fuels stronger ideas, and open dialogue drives sharper decisions. Recognized as a Best Place to Work and one of Deloitte's fastest\-growing companies for the past 5 years, we're here to raise the standard for what cloud security and workplace culture should be.

If you have the passion to dig deeper, the desire to challenge convention, and the curiosity to build something better, Sysdig is the right place for you.
### **What you will do**

* Author Sysdig's enablement charter and operating model — what enablement owns, how success is measured, and how it's inspected — and get sign\-off from Sales, CS, and RevOps leadership.
* Own new\-hire onboarding and the certification framework for GTM roles, with a clear, measured path to productivity. Build the ongoing recertification cadence so the program holds up as the team and product evolve.
* Drive adoption and reinforcement of our sales methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) and equip managers to coach it day\-to\-day. Coordinate delivery for major GTM moments like SKO and product launches, partnering with Product Marketing, who owns the underlying content.
* Own the enablement tech stack (LMS, conversation intelligence) and drive structured adoption of AI\-native GTM tools like Clay and enterprise Claude across the revenue org — role\-based training and champions, not one\-off demos.
* Build and maintain the enablement KPI scorecard — leading indicators like training completion and certification pass rates, lagging indicators like ramp time and win rate — and use it to show where programs are and aren't moving the business.
* Partner with Product Marketing on content adoption (they create, including battlecards; you drive field usage), RevOps on systems and reporting, and Sales/CS leadership to keep the roadmap tied to real pipeline and retention priorities.

### **What you will bring with you**

* 5–8\+ years in sales, revenue, or GTM enablement, including experience building or significantly rebuilding a program (not just running an existing one).
* A track record of designing measurement frameworks
* Hands\-on fluency with modern GTM and enablement tooling: LMS/content platforms, conversation intelligence (e.g., Gong), and AI\-native GTM tools (e.g., Clay) and enterprise AI assistants (e.g., Claude) — you direct these tools and drive adoption, not just use them yourself.
* Experience with a sales methodology framework (e.g., MEDDPICC, Command of the Message) and reinforcing it through coaching, not just a slide deck.
* Excellent cross\-functional collaboration skills — you can align Sales, CS, RevOps, and Product Marketing around a shared enablement plan without owning their turf.
* A builder's mindset: comfortable defining charter and structure where none exists yet, and comfortable being judged on adoption and business metrics, not activity.

### **What we look for**

* Prior enablement experience in cybersecurity, cloud security, or infrastructure software.
* Experience standing up or significantly evolving an enablement function at a company going through a platform or GTM transformation.
* Experience running AI adoption/change\-management programs (usage metrics, champions programs, structured rollout) rather than ad hoc tool training.

Its mission is to bring about health equity by collaborating with community\-based partners and providing technical assistance, training, evaluation, and inspiration. CHEER focuses on underserved populations, with a particular emphasis on maternal child health and nutrition.

CHAMPS is a hospital\-based initiative that promotes evidence\-based maternity practices, with the ultimate goal of increasing breastfeeding rates and decreasing racial disparities in breastfeeding. The new CHAMPS National program is a CDC funded program, which expands hospital enrollment to 100 sites around the US and its territories. The SRPM will develop protocols, assessment instruments, monitor program implementation, provide training, and assist with manuscripts, presentations and reporting to the CDC. **OMEGA SYSTEMS JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position:** Project Manager  

**Reports To:** VP of Service Delivery
  

**Division:** Technical Services
  

**FSLA:** Exempt  

  

This role is responsible for executing projects within established timelines, budgets, and quality standards while coordinating Systems Engineers and Project Engineers responsible for implementation. While not hands on technical, the Project Manager must possess strong technical literacy to translate SOWs into actionable plans, manage dependencies and risk, and ensure successful project delivery. You will partner with Engineers, CSMs, Account Managers, and clients to provide clear status reporting, maintain documentation, and uphold PMP based project management practices in a fast paced environment.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead project delivery from SOW to closeout: develop project plans, define milestones, resource assignments, acceptance criteria, and change control processes.
* Consolidate and prioritize multiple concurrent projects across accounts: maintain program level roadmaps, identify conflicts, sequence work to optimize engineer utilization and client impact.
* Coordinate cross functional stakeholders: work with Engineers, CSMs, AMs, and third party vendors to align expectations, scope, schedules, and deliverables.
* Resource and schedule management: assign engineers to tasks based on skills and availability, monitor workload, proactively rebalance assignments, and support time management to meet SLAs and timelines.
* Communication and reporting: produce and distribute regular status updates, executive summaries, project dashboards, and risk/issue logs to internal teams and client stakeholders.
* Risk, issue, and change control: identify and document risks, own mitigation plans, manage scope change requests, and obtain approvals per governance processes.
* Meeting facilitation and client engagement: run project kickoff, steering committee, and weekly status meetings; present technical progress in business terms for non technical stakeholders.
* Quality and acceptance: ensure engineers produce required technical deliverables (design docs, runbooks, test plans) and that acceptance criteria in the SOW are validated and signed off.
* Continuous improvement: capture lessons learned, refine project templates, and share best practices to improve delivery efficiency and documentation quality.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* PMP certification with 5\+ years managing technical projects; MSP experience preferred.

* Strong stakeholder management skills: proven experience working with client executives, CSMs, AMs, technical teams, and vendors.
* Excellent written and verbal communication: status reports, executive summaries, and client facing updates.
* Solid scheduling and resource management skills: familiarity with MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent; comfortable optimizing engineer assignments and availability.
* Risk and change management proficiency: establish and run escalation paths, change approval workflows, and issue resolution processes.
* Process orientation and documentation skills: create and maintain project artifacts, RACI matrices, runbooks, and acceptance checklists.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
As a founding member of our rapidly evolving Project Management team, you will provide end\-to\-end ownership of complex, high\-impact new product development (NPD) programs. You will lead multiple cross\-functional teams through the NPD process from concept to retail launch, ensuring projects are delivered on time, on cost, and on spec.


Because our PMO is a newly established function, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our operational standards, creating deep and meaningful partnerships companywide, and demonstrating project management's strategic value. You serve as a strategic partner, facilitator, and escalation point—driving alignment at leadership levels, navigating high ambiguity, and setting the standard for execution excellence.

**Responsibilities**


Responsibilities are executed in alignment with PMO standards, methodologies, and the Project Management Competency Matrix. Duties include but are not limited to:

* **Project \& Timeline Management:** Own and drive multiple large or complex NPD programs simultaneously through the Phase Gate process. Develop and manage integrated timelines, anticipate delivery risks, and lead cross‑functional teams through trade‑off decisions to protect timing, cost, and scope. This is a leadership role focused on ownership and outcomes, not task execution for other functions. Actively help define and refine our NPD gates and milestones as our PMO matures.
* **Product \& Cross‑Functional Leadership:** Partner closely with Product Managers, Marketing, R\&D, Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, Quality, and Creative at both working and leadership levels. Facilitate high‑impact meetings, drive decision‑making, and ensure alignment on priorities, commitments, and deliverables across functions.
* **Advanced Risk Management:** Proactively identify, assess, and manage risks across programs with significant business impact. Develop mitigation and contingency plans, escalate appropriately, and prevent late‑stage surprises through early visibility and action.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Provide clear, concise, and strategic project updates to cross‑functional leaders and stakeholders. Influence alignment and decision‑making by clearly communicating risks, trade‑offs, and recommendations.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Lead efforts to strengthen PMO processes, tools, and standards. Identify systemic gaps across teams and drive improvements that enable more predictable, efficient, and scalable product launches. Help design, pilot, and champion new PMO tools, templates, and communication cadences that make the team more efficient.

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree required (Business, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, or similar).
* Typically 7–10\+ years of professional experience, including extensive ownership of complex NPD programs.

**Technical Skills**

* Expert proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and project management tools.

**Management Skills**

* **Detail‑Oriented:** Manages complex, interdependent project details across multiple programs, anticipating downstream impacts to scope, timing, cost, and quality. Identifies patterns and systemic risks early to prevent escalation and late‑stage disruption.
* **Communication:** Provides clear, concise, and strategic verbal and written communication across all levels of the organization, including senior leadership. Translates complex project dynamics into decision‑ready insights that drive alignment and action.
* **Problem‑Solving:** Anticipates obstacles before they emerge, quickly assesses root causes, and guides teams toward practical, durable solutions that balance business priorities and execution realities.
* **Cross‑Functional Fluency:** Demonstrates deep fluency across Brand, Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, Quality, and other partner functions. Uses this understanding to drive effective collaboration, sound trade‑offs, and strong execution outcomes.
* **Adaptability \& Ambiguity:** Thrives in high‑pressure, fast‑changing environments with competing priorities. Leads teams confidently through ambiguity, maintaining momentum and focus despite shifting inputs or incomplete information.

**Interpersonal Skills**

* **Mediator, not Participant:** Leads as an objective, unbiased truth teller who balances competing functional priorities and interests. Facilitates tough conversations, surfaces hard truths early, and drives fair, informed outcomes aligned to overall business goals.
* **Conflict Navigation:** Navigates complex, high‑stakes conflicts across teams and leadership levels with sound judgment. Resolves competing priorities constructively, escalating appropriately to protect project outcomes.
* **Calm in the Storm:** Maintains composure, clarity, and decisiveness during periods of significant pressure or uncertainty. Sets the tone for teams, helping others remain focused and productive during tight deadlines or critical moments.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Builds strong, trust‑based relationships across the organization and influences outcomes through credibility and expertise. Effectively drives commitment, accountability, and follow‑through without relying on formal authority.
* **Attention to Detail:** Continuously monitors program health at both project and portfolio levels, ensuring small gaps or inconsistencies are identified early and do not scale into larger delivery or quality issues.

US$130,000\.00 \- US$140,000\.00 Annually

Employees in this role are eligible to participate in the company's benefits program, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company matching, accrued vacation, floating holidays, and designated company holidays.

**Position Title:** Custom Jewelry Project Manager

  

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**


At CustomMade, we believe engagement rings should be as personal as the relationships they represent. We make it easy to create a ring that's both one\-of\-a\-kind and affordable. Turns out people really like that and word is really spreading quickly! We've created 30,000 pieces of custom jewelry and helped 12,000 couples get engaged, but we're still just getting started reshaping the jewelry industry.


As our business continues to grow, we are looking for additional Custom Jewelry Project Managers to join our team of around 50\.


**ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY**


Our offering is built on a one\-on\-one, specialized, and custom design experience and service. As a Custom Jewelry Project Manager you'll be at the heart of that, working with customers from initial request all the way to a fully designed one of a kind piece. You'll be the face of our company to the customer, coordinating with our designers, gem experts, and production specialists to help design and create their dream ring.


In this role, you'll be evaluated primarily on your ability to connect with customers, coordinate design and gem selection, and effectively execute the customer's design vision. Each project you handle will be unique and require creativity, discretion, and independent judgment. Our customers are at the heart of our process and, as a Custom Jewelry Project Manager, you'll be an integral part of both their success and ours.


**A typical day would include things like:**


* Building and maintaining customer relationships:
* Work closely with new and existing customers through online messaging.
* Manage ongoing relationships with existing customers and support on their future projects
* Sharing design and material expertise:
* Understand key customer preferences to bring their design ideas to life
* Make thoughtful design and material recommendations that align with the customer's priorities
* Coordinate with our technical teams to successfully translate the customer's vision into a manufacturable design
* Present concept sketches and 3D renderings to customers, answering questions and receiving feedback for subsequent revisions
* Communicate design revisions to our CAD designers and concept sketch artists
* Share and discuss diamond or gem options
* Managing the overall success of your projects:
* Approach each project individually to make the design and development process fun and easy for the customer based on their needs and working style
* Create and present quotes for customers that fit their budget and design requirements
* Plan and manage project timelines with consideration of sketch, CAD, and manufacturing to ensure deadlines are met
* Handle all post\-production related correspondence, including resizing, repairs, maintenance, and customer satisfaction.
* Contributing to internal development:
* Review communication techniques, technical guidance, and project strategy feedback with your manager
* Experiment with new approaches and resources with the guidance of your manager
* Establish and maintain positive working relationships with other Project Managers and cross functional partners
* We are open to in\-office candidates (Cambridge, MA) and remote candidates. Our business is fully online, so no in\-office presence is required.


**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS:**


* Competitive base compensation \+ added commission
* $65,000\- $68,000/yr total on\-target earnings
* $45,000/yr base compensation \+ commission of 4\.5% of sales
* This is a full\-time role with full benefits (health, vision, dental)
* 401k match
* Employee jewelry discount
* Holidays and paid time off
* Standard business hours, Monday\-Friday schedule

  

**QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS, \& ABILITIES**


* Excellent written communication skills, ability to communicate clearly with personality through written text
* Client\-facing experience in sales, hospitality, luxury retail, or account management
* A passion for jewelry and design and an interest in the creative development process
* Discerning visual taste
* Resourcefulness \- the ability to make good decisions in the absence of perfect information
* Preferred but not required
* A track record of achieving strong sales results
* Experience in fine jewelry sales
* Technical experience as a jewelry designer, bench jeweler, or artist
* Graduate Gemologist degree or previous Gemological Institute of America (GIA) course work
* Bachelor's degree from a competitive college/university


Interested in this role but don't meet all the requirements listed? We'd still love to hear from you! Apply and share why you think you're right for the job and what sets you apart.

  

  

CustomMade is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Reporting & Compliance Quality Assurance Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Built by enterprise software engineers and compliance experts, we provide comprehensive Affordable Care Act (ACA) reporting and compliance services. Our team of seasoned ACA specialists, data integration experts, in\-house legal counsel, and accounting professionals delivers accurate, efficient, and trustworthy service to every client.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a detail\-oriented, experienced Quality Assurance (QA) Manager to lead the process behind our ACA compliance deliverables. This role does not focus on finding or fixing every error directly \- rather, it focuses on catching the exceptions: patterns, inconsistencies, and edge cases that indicate a deliverable isn't ready for client review.

As the QA Manager, you will oversee the review of completed ACA Forms 1094\-C and 1095\-C work prepared by our analyst team, verify that coding and documentation meet internal standards, and ensure every deliverable is accurate, defensible, and audit\-ready before it reaches the client. This role requires technical knowledge of ACA employer reporting requirements, and sharp pattern\-recognition skills.

If you enjoy digging into data to find the exception that everyone else missed, thrive under deadline pressure, and take pride in building a team that delivers accurate ACA reporting and compliance work, we look forward to hearing from you!

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review completed ACA reporting deliverables for accuracy, consistency, and completeness prior to client delivery
* Verify Line 14, 15, and 16 coding against plan details, employee eligibility, classification, enrollment, and affordability requirements
* Identify coding inconsistencies between current and prior filing years, and confirm that any changes are properly explained
* Run and review error reports to catch missing data, incorrect codes, or discrepancies between source files and final output
* Cross\-check questionnaire responses against how each case was actually coded and processed
* Verify that every enrolled individual is accounted for, appropriately documented, and matched with a corresponding form
* Spot\-check high\-risk scenarios, including mid\-year terminations, rehires, status changes, and multi\-FEIN employers
* Ensure findings, exceptions, and assumptions are clearly documented in tickets and supporting files
* Maintain consistent file naming, folder structure, and documentation standards across the QA process
* Provide feedback to analysts to improve accuracy and reduce recurring errors
* Collaborate with account managers and analysts to resolve open questions before deliverables are finalized

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Excel Proficiency: VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP, INDEX / MATCH, Pivot Tables, Nested IF statements, Logical / Array formulas
* Minimum of two years hands\-on experience preparing Forms 1094 and 1095 C\-series. B series and/or ICHRA experience is a plus
* Working knowledge of ACA employer reporting requirements under IRC §6055 and §6056
* Strong understanding of Line 14/15/16 coding logic, safe harbor determinations, and affordability analysis
* High attention to detail and the ability to identify patterns or anomalies across large, multi\-source datasets
* Strong written communication skills for documenting findings, exceptions, and client\-facing notes
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced, remote environment

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience leading, training, or mentoring
* Experience with quality assurance, audit, or error\-report review processes
* Exposure to HRIS/payroll data sources (e.g., ADP, Paylocity, UKG, Employee Navigator)
* Prior experience in a client\-facing or project coordination role
* Familiarity with Excel add\-ins such as Power Query that streamline data cleanup and processing.

**Interview Process**

As a remote team, we require applicants to demonstrate their ability to work independently via an Excel\-based **Technical Abilities Assessment**.

If your qualifications and experience are a match, you will receive an invitation to schedule the day and time of assessment. A packet including detailed instructions for processing and submission will then be sent for completion within 90 minutes or less.

**Why Join Us?**

* A clear path for growth, salary increases, and seasonal bonuses based on performance
* Hands\-on leadership role shaping the quality and accuracy of every client deliverable
* Work with a supportive, collaborative team of ACA specialists, data experts, and compliance professionals
* Opportunity to mentor and develop a growing analyst team
* Learn and help refine industry best practices in ACA compliance quality control
* Work environment that values precision, accountability, and getting it right the first time

**Job Details**

* Job Type: Full\-Time
* Compensation: $70,000 – $100,000
* Pay Basis: Salaried
* Work Location: Remote
* Schedule: Regular Business Hours plus availability during ACA peak filing season (December–April), including some evenings and weekends as deadlines required
* Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) \+ Match, Ancillary (*Details at offer stage*), Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Performance\-based Bonus
* Background check and confidentiality agreement required, given the sensitivity of the data handled in this role

Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Have you been responsible for reviewing or approving another person's ACA reporting work before it went to a client?
* Which of the following have you used unassisted in the past 12 months? (Select all that apply): INDEX/MATCH, XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Nested IF/IFS, None of these

Experience:

**About Us:**
ChowNow is one of the leading players in off\-premise restaurant technology. As takeout becomes a vital revenue stream for independent restaurants, our platform helps owners focus on what they do best—serving great food—by offering solutions across the entire digital dining experience. From building branded websites and mobile apps, to powering online orders, managing menus, consolidating delivery, and running targeted marketing, we give restaurants the tools to grow on their own terms.

We support **thousands of** **restaurants across North America**, helping process **$1B\+ in gross food sales** while saving our partners over **$700M in third\-party commission fees**. Through our white\-label ordering solutions, a growing demand network (including Google, Yelp, Apple, and Snap), and a diner\-friendly marketplace, we empower independent restaurants to own their customer relationships and avoid inflated pricing and fees charged by 3rd party delivery apps like Uber and Doordash.

Founded in 2012, we’ve navigated rapid growth and transformation—from startup roots through the pandemic boom—and are now beginning an exciting new era under our CEO, **Kanika Soni**. As we evolve with new leadership and cutting\-edge tools, we’re deepening our commitment to helping local restaurants thrive in the digital economy.

**About the Position:**
We're looking for a strategic, AI and data\-driven Senior Revenue Enablement Program Manager to accelerate the performance of our Revenue organization. The Enablement team sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations and is responsible for driving AI strategy across revenue\-facing teams. This is a hands\-on role for someone who's excited about where AI can take us and has real\-world experience using tools like Claude and GPT in their day\-to\-day workflow.
  

A core part of this role is using AI to close the gap between "we know what reps should be doing differently" and "reps are actually doing it." You'll be expected to identify specific productivity and skill gaps from call, pipeline, and performance data, then design AI\-powered workflows — not just AI\-assisted content — that put the right nudge, prompt, or resource in front of the right rep at the right moment in their selling motion. This is a build\-and\-operate mandate, not a research project: you're expected to ship workflows that measurably change rep behavior.  

  

In addition, you will lead enablement initiatives including but not limited to: new product launches, pricing and packaging rollouts, everboarding programs, skills development, and process adoption. You won't just deliver training — you'll design scalable systems that improve execution quality, shorten sales cycles, increase win rates, and elevate seller confidence.
  

This is a highly cross\-functional, high\-visibility role for someone who thrives in fast\-moving environments, doesn’t let things slip through the cracks even though they are juggling multiple initiatives at once, knows how to influence senior stakeholders which includes our CEO, and can connect enablement efforts directly to business outcomes.

This position will report to our Director of Revenue Enablement. No direct reports.

This is a remote role based in the United States. **Please note:** ChowNow is not eligible to employ in every state and the recruiting team will confirm location and eligibility before moving past initial stages.

**WHAT WE LOVE ABOUT YOU:**

**You put restaurants first.** You deeply understand the importance of local restaurants and put them at the center of everything you do. You aim to help them not only survive but thrive.

**You celebrate diversity.** You recognize that diversity and inclusivity matter. You’re committed to progress, which means everyone gets the support and resources they need, no matter who they are. You have an ability to listen to other team members' ideas and can thrive in an environment that embraces individuality. Everyone’s voice counts.

**You raise your hand.** You consistently go above and beyond what is asked of you. You help your peers accomplish their tasks while also excelling at accomplishing your own. When you have a smart idea, you raise your hand and share it.

**You keep reaching.** You set clear ambitious goals. You don’t allow yourself to become complacent with where you’re at and what you’ve done, so you seek out new opportunities and challenges.
### **Responsibilities Include:**

jobs.description:
Mylan Institutional Inc.
Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high\-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases.


We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making.


Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Key Account Manager, Institutional Sales – Carolinas role will make an impact:


Key responsibilities for this role include:

* Territories include North and South Carolina.
* Portfolio of responsibilities include: Generic Injectables, and some brands across all North America Businesses.
* Analyze sales data for portfolio of more than 180 Injectable NDCs. Manage position and pricing for each customer depending on the Acute and Non\-Acute Care GPO’s as well as alternate contracts, including back\-up and IDNs.
* Drive compliance to GPO awards but also position back\-up contracts to sell the entire portfolio of Viatris products to customers.
* Awareness and insight to competitive awards and market position and associated contracts to aid in sales positioning, pull\-through as well as RFP processes.

Support customers with drop ships as needed. Communicate shortages and duration to supply chain to aid in the determination of forecast and demand planning.
* Understanding of National Wholesalers and forward distribution centers. Working with Buyers, Customer Relations, and National Account Managers to ensure that appropriate inventory is stocked for the Hospital to purchase.
* Ensure pricing is loaded accurately and validate contract eligibility for customers for accounting team as needed.
* Collaborate with other business units’ sales, leadership and pricing teams.
* Conduct all activities in accordance while meeting Compliance standards, as well as all applicable laws and regulations, and Viatris policies and procedures.
* Participate in Conferences and Advisory Boards in a rotation with other colleagues and ensure weekly engagement and participation on Friday Sales Calls.
* Develop and maintain deep relationships with customers and communicate with them to promote contract compliance and the use of Viatris products.
* Cover a prescribed customer call cycle and conduct an account review for each customer relating to new and existing products, contract information (if applicable), purchasing history and provide assistance and product information as necessary.
* Maintain updated customer account profiles and client tracking information. Continually update relevant contract information, (i.e., pricing, addendum’s, and contract or member additions or deletions).
* Analyze sales figures and territory data for accounts on a routine basis or as requested by District Sales Manager. Interpret findings and draw conclusions.
* Monitor competitor activities and pricing and communicate pertinent information in a timely manner to the District Sales Manager and/or appropriate corporate personnel by phone or via voicemail, followed by written confirmation.

* Four\-year college degree required. Three years minimum experience in pharmaceutical industry or medical sales. Institutional or Hospital sales experience preferred. However, a combination of experience and/or education will be taken into consideration.

At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.


Viatris is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
